items.title: Anthropic揭Claude Code「省錢6招」！善用快取、/clear降低Token成本
paras: Anthropic近日發布一篇部落格文章，針對開發者使用Claude Code時容易出現的Token浪費問題，整理出6項降低成本的實用技巧。
官方指出，Claude Code的使用成本不只取決於選用哪個模型，也與推理強度、上下文長度及提示快取是否命中密切相關；若缺乏上下文管理，同一項程式開發任務的成本可能出現數倍差距。
Anthropic建議，開發者完成一項任務後應立即使用「/clear」清除對話，避免前一項工作的檔案內容、指令輸出與探索過程持續留在上下文中，並在開始工作時就確定模型與推理強度，減少後續切換造成的快取失效。

Anthropic列6招降低Claude Code成本


在不同任務之間執行「/clear」，避免把之前無關的上下文繼續送到模型，進而減少Token消耗。
開始工作前，先確定好模型和推理強度，因為中途更改其中任何一個，都可能導致提示詞快取失效，進而增加Token成本。
不要只寫出檔名，而是直接用「@」提及文件，使檔案會直接附加到訊息中，省去一次Read調用，並避免Claude再去搜尋檔案。
對輸出冗長的指令加上靜默參數，或把指令交給子代理執行。因為命令輸出會像檔案一樣加入對話，並且在整個會話期間都會保留。
在新會話開始時執行一次「/context」。它會顯示目前載入的內容（例如 CLAUDE.md 和 MCP 工具定義），方便用戶刪除不必要的內容。
暫時離開鍵盤前執行「/compact」。提示詞快取通常一小時後就會過期，而在快取仍然有效時進行對話壓縮，成本要低得多。


Claude Code成本關鍵在Token如何被計算

Anthropic也進一步說明Claude Code背後的Token消耗機制。每次使用者發出指令時，模型首先需要進行「預填充」，讀取系統提示詞、CLAUDE.md、使用者訊息及過往對話等輸入內容；接著進入「解碼」（decode）階段，產生模型回覆、思考內容及工具呼叫等輸出。
兩者的運算方式並不相同。預填充會一次處理輸入內容，而解碼則是逐個Token產生輸出，因此輸出Token的成本高於輸入Token。
模型本身則決定每個Token的價格，而推理強度會影響Token使用量。
Anthropic指出，推理強度越高，模型需要產生的思考Token越多，因此開發者不應在所有任務上都使用最高推理強度，而應根據工作的複雜程度選擇合適的模型與設定。

提示快取成為降低成本的重要工具

在Claude Code的成本結構中，提示快取是另一個關鍵因素。
Claude Code的請求通常會包含相同的前綴，例如系統提示詞、工具定義、CLAUDE.md以及既有對話歷史。如果下一次請求的前綴內容與前一次完全一致，系統可以直接使用先前的計算結果，而不必重新處理全部內容。
Anthropic指出，快取讀取只要正常輸入價的0.1倍，可以直接省掉90%。雖然首次寫入快取需要較高成本，但之後的請求可以持續利用既有快取。
不過，快取並非永久有效，而且必須維持連續匹配。Anthropic列出幾種可能導致快取失效的情況，包括切換模型、改變推理強度、開啟或關閉Fast mode、使用「/compact」重新整理對話、快取逾期，以及長時間後恢復舊會話。
其中，模型與推理強度的切換尤其值得注意。Anthropic指出，不同模型各自擁有獨立快取，因此從一個模型切換到另一個模型後，原本的對話歷史可能需要重新進行預填充；推理強度同樣屬於快取條件之一。
此外，Anthropic也提醒使用者注意「opusplan」模式。由於該模式會在不同階段切換模型，因此進入或離開相關模式都可能造成快取失效，頻繁切換可能增加額外成本。

對話越長，累積成本也越高

即使成功利用快取降低重複處理成本，Anthropic仍提醒，對話本身持續膨脹仍會增加Token使用量。
Claude每讀取一個檔案、執行一次指令，都可能將相關內容加入對話歷史。隨著工作輪數增加，後續請求需要攜帶的上下文也會越來越長。
Claude Code設有機制處理過大的命令輸出：當輸出超過一定長度時，內容會被寫入暫存檔案，而對話中只保留摘要。不過，較短但仍然龐大的輸出仍可能直接留在上下文中。
例如測試工具產生大量測試結果，即使沒有超過系統設定的門檻，這些內容仍可能持續佔據後續對話空間。
因此，Anthropic再次強調，讓命令保持精簡、將大型工作交給子代理，以及適時清除或壓縮對話，都是降低上下文膨脹的重要方式。
除了「/clear」與「/compact」之外，Anthropic也提到「/rewind」。如果最近幾輪對話出現偏離，可以利用「/rewind」移除後續內容，同時保留較早的對話與快取狀態。

AI程式開發開始出現「Token管理」能力

從Anthropic整理的這些技巧可以看出，Claude Code的使用效率已不只是模型能力或程式設計技巧的問題，如何管理上下文、控制輸出、維持快取及選擇適當推理強度，也逐漸成為影響開發成本的重要因素。
對開發者而言，真正需要避免的並非單次使用大量Token，而是在長時間、多輪次的工作流程中，讓無關的上下文不斷累積，並因模型或設定切換導致原本可以重複利用的快取失效。
Anthropic此次公布的6項建議，核心邏輯也相當明確：讓每一次請求只攜帶真正需要的內容、讓能夠快取的內容持續命中，並將不必要的大量輸出隔離在主對話之外。對於高頻率使用Claude Code的開發者而言，這些操作將直接影響相同工作量下的Token消耗。

items.title: 距發表還一個月！電商不怕臨時改模 搶先開賣折疊iPhone殼  配件商打什麼算盤？
items.title_en: Apple's Foldable iPhone Looms, but Accessories Sellers Are Already Racing to Market
paras: 距蘋果首款折疊iPhone與iPhone 18系列正式亮相還有一個月左右，但電商平台上的「配件搶跑」已開跑，不少店家直接以「iPhone Fold」、「iPhone Ultra」為關鍵字上架折疊手機殼，未發布的iPhone 18系列保護殼、鋼化膜也同步現身，部分商品甚至按機型、材質、款式細分完畢。
《每日經濟新聞》報導，當記者以消費者身份詢價，商家多不願透露數據來源，只強調「工廠包數據、按數據開模」「確定可適配」，若日後改模會補發，但一款手機殼從開模、打樣到備庫存，本就牽動整條供應鏈，未發布就量產，本質是場高風險押注。
長期經營蘋果生態配件的業內人士表示，第三方廠商慣例會提前三個月備戰，搶的是新機上市首波「買機必買殼」的窗口，等蘋果發表再開發，黃金流量早已過去。資訊來源則不只靠官方，量產階段供應鏈外溢、機模流出、渲染圖與產業爆料，都足以讓成熟廠商憑尺寸、鏡頭位、按鍵佈局先行開模。
報導指出，今年還多了一個特殊變量，蘋果印度核心代工廠塔塔電子6月遭勒索攻擊，超20萬份、630GB機密文件(含主板圖紙、晶片參數、真機測試片)流入暗網，被稱為蘋果史上最嚴重洩密事件，新德里已介入調查，這讓配件廠能拿到的「公開情報」比往年更紮實。
不過，風險也更高。直板iPhone迭代多年，手機殼廠有經驗累積，折疊螢幕涉及鉸鏈、機身厚度、開合結構與螢幕形態，任一關鍵尺寸變動都可能讓前期開模作廢重來，也就是說折疊款「搶跑」賭注遠大於Pro機種。
知情人士透露，蘋果擬於下月只發表兩款高階Pro與首款折疊 iPhone，2027上半年再把標準版與SE整合發布，形成「Pro 秋發、基礎款春發」的拆分節奏。對配件產業鏈而言，過去一年一次秋季集中備貨，未來可能拆成多個時間窗口，從「一年一站集中搶跑」轉向「長周期、高頻接力」。
搶跑看似只是電商常態，實則映出蘋果保密防線鬆動、供應鏈情報商品化，以及 iPhone 產品節奏重組三股力量交疊。新機還沒露面，圍繞它的千億配件生意，已經先跑完了第一圈。
paras_en: Just a month before Apple's first foldable iPhone and iPhone 18 series are set to debut, e-commerce platforms have already seen a rush of 'accessory pre-sales.' Many sellers have listed foldable phone cases under keywords like 'iPhone Fold' and 'iPhone Ultra,' with some even offering cases for the yet-to-be-released iPhone 18 series and screen protectors.

According to a report by the Daily Economic News, when reporters inquired about prices as consumers, many sellers refused to disclose their data sources, only stating that they had 'factory data' and 'opened molds based on data.' If the design were to change later, they would issue a recall, but one phone case from mold opening to inventory storage is a high-risk gamble.

Industry insiders who have long operated in the Apple ecosystem noted that third-party manufacturers typically prepare three months in advance to secure a head start on the initial 'buy-a-phone-buy-a-case' window. They wait for Apple's official release before developing new products, as the golden opportunity has already passed.

The information source is not limited to official channels. During the production stage, supply chain leaks, prototype designs, and industry rumors can all provide enough information for mature manufacturers to develop cases based on dimensions, camera placement, and button layouts.

This year, there is an additional variable: Apple's Indian core manufacturing partner, Tata Electronics, was hit by a ransomware attack in June, resulting in over 200,000 leaked files (including motherboard diagrams, chip parameters, and real-machine test pieces) on the dark web, dubbed the most severe data breach in Apple's history. New Delhi has intervened in the investigation, giving accessory manufacturers more substantial 'public information' than in previous years.

However, the risks are higher. The flat iPhone has undergone numerous iterations, giving case manufacturers valuable experience. The foldable screen involves hinges, body thickness, opening and closing structures, and screen shape, making any key dimension change potentially render pre-made molds obsolete. In other words, the 'pre-sale' gamble for foldable cases is much greater than that for Pro models.

Sources close to the matter revealed that Apple plans to release only two high-end Pro models and the first foldable iPhone in the coming month, with standard and SE models to be released in the first half of 2027, forming a 'Pro autumn release, basic model spring release' schedule. For the accessory industry, this means a shift from 'one-time concentrated pre-sales' to 'long-cycle, high-frequency relay' production.

paras:
8/17台股盤前要聞

1.台股加權指數上周續彈1585點，即將挑戰站穩46000點上，三大法人同步買超，呈現籌碼面和技術面均偏多的態勢，再加上新台幣升破32元價位在望，台股交易員認為，台股多頭匯集，惟8月以來已反彈2691點，漲多後逢上檔層層反壓需要時間，預料進入財報空窗期後透過資金面的回補，先呈現驚驚漲格局為優。
2.主計總處14日公布今明年台灣經濟成長率(GDP)最新預測值，由於上半年經濟成長14.15%，上修1.50個百分點，下半年預測成長8.27%，上修1.33個百分點，使全年GDP將衝上11.05%，上修1.41個百分點，創1988年以來最高紀錄，而消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率2.07%略高於台灣央行通膨警戒線2%。
3.新一代AI伺服器將導入800V HVDC供電架構，帶動碳化矽(SiC)重要性快速提升，近期市場除傳出SiC報價調漲，也出現新一輪擴產訊號，中國大廠宣布產能目標倍增，台灣相關供應鏈也同步受惠，包括環球晶(6488-TW)、合晶(6182-TW)以及廣運(6125-TW)集團旗下盛新材料，SiC相關訂單與營運動能可望進一步增強。
4.美國針對無人機及相關零組件祭出的「232關稅措施」將於9月3日上路，經濟部14日表示，將加速推動國內認驗證體系與美國標準接軌，協助業者取得輸美資格及認證。同時，依據美方公布內容，台灣與歐盟、日本、韓國及瑞士同列低稅率優惠名單，只要符合關鍵零組件及技術來源規定，即可適用15%關稅，有助維持我國無人機產品輸美競爭優勢，並爭取全球供應鏈移轉商機。

5.13家上市金控2026年7月自結獲利全數出爐！受7月全球金融市場波動加劇、美台股市震盪拉回影響，壽險與證券子公司評價及投資收益遭遇亂流，致使13家金控單月稅後純益合計降至518.94億元，較6月下滑約29.39%，由國泰金控奪下單月獲利王。不過，今年前7月資本市場活絡、銀行核心業務放款與財管手續費維持強勁成長，13家金控前7月累計稅後純益達4,927.82億元，較去年同期大幅成長124.78%，續創歷年同期新高，富邦金控仍為累計獲利王。
6.ASIC業者世芯-KY(3661-TW)14日召開法說會，董事長沈翔霖指出，下一代2奈米(N2) AI加速器已進入最終階段，維持今年底前完成設計定案(Tape-out)、2027年底進入量產的目標，預期該產品單價將遠高於目前量產中的N3世代，未來出貨量也確定高於N3，呈現價量齊揚，也看好明年N3出貨有機會優於預期，暗示營收仍有上調空間。

paras_en: 1. Taiwan's weighted stock index rebounded by 1585 points last week and is about to challenge the 46,000-point level. The three major institutional investors have all bought stocks, showing a bullish trend in both the market's sentiment and technical indicators. With the New Taiwan dollar expected to break through the NT$32 level, stock traders believe that the Taiwan stock market is dominated by bulls, but the market has rebounded by 2691 points since August, and after a strong rally, it needs time to digest the gains. It is expected that after the earnings season, the market will recover through capital inflows, and the initial stage of the rally will be a 'surprise' rally.

2. The Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics announced on the 14th that the latest GDP growth rate forecast for this year and next year has been revised upward. The GDP growth rate for the first half of the year was 14.15%, an increase of 1.50 percentage points, and the growth rate for the second half of the year is expected to be 8.27%, an increase of 1.33 percentage points. As a result, the annual GDP growth rate is expected to reach 11.05%, an increase of 1.41 percentage points, setting a new record since 1988. The consumer price index (CPI) year-over-year growth rate was 2.07%, slightly higher than the Taiwan central bank's 2% inflation warning line.

3. The new generation of AI servers will adopt 800V HVDC power supply architecture, which will rapidly increase the importance of silicon carbide (SiC). In recent times, the market has seen reports of SiC price increases and new production expansions. China's large manufacturers have announced plans to double their production capacity, and Taiwan's related supply chain has also benefited, including Global Crystal Materials (6488-TW), Hsinchu Crystal (6182-TW), and Guangyun Group's (6125-TW) Shengxin Materials. The SiC-related orders and operating capacity are expected to further increase.

4. The US has announced a 232 tariff measure on unmanned aircraft and related components, which will take effect on September 3. The Ministry of Economic Affairs stated on the 14th that it will accelerate the promotion of domestic certification and verification systems to align with US standards, helping local companies to obtain export qualifications and certifications. At the same time, according to the US announcement, Taiwan, the EU, Japan, South Korea, and Switzerland are all included in the list of countries with low tariff rates. If the companies meet the requirements for key components and technology sources, they can enjoy a 15% tariff rate, which will help maintain Taiwan's competitive advantage in exporting unmanned aircraft products and seek opportunities for global supply chain transfer.

5. The 13 listed financial holding companies released their July financial reports, which showed that the combined net profit of the 13 companies in July was NT$51.894 billion, a decrease of 29.39% from June. However, the companies' capital market business was active in the first seven months of the year, and their core banking business and financial management fees maintained strong growth. The combined net profit of the 13 companies in the first seven months of the year was NT$49.278 billion, a year-on-year increase of 124.78%, setting a new high for the same period. Fubon Financial Holding Co. still holds the title of cumulative net profit king.

6. ASIC manufacturer, Sino-American Silicon Products Inc. (3661-TW), held a shareholders' meeting on the 14th, where Chairman Shen Xianglin stated that the next-generation 2-nanometer (N2) AI accelerator has entered the final stage. The company aims to complete the design and tape-out by the end of the year and enter mass production by the end of 2027. The product's price is expected to be significantly higher than the current N3 generation, and the sales volume is expected to be higher than N3. This will result in a 'price-quantity' combination, and the company is optimistic about the sales volume of N3 in the coming year, which may exceed expectations, indicating that the company's revenue still has room for upward revision.
7. Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: The market has rebounded by 2700 points since August, and the sentiment has turned strong, which will help the market to continue its 'surprise' rally.
8. The Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics estimates that Taiwan's GDP will reach 11.05% this year, setting a new record since 1988.
9. Guangyun Group is laying out its strategy in the AI, semiconductor, and robotics industries, and its team is leading the way for another 50 years.
10. Shipping Index: SCFI has risen for three consecutive days, and the freight rate on the US East Coast may break through the US$10,000 mark.
11. Taiwan Dollar: The NT dollar broke through the NT$32 level and reached NT$32.046, a strong increase of 1.22 cents.

12. The 13 listed financial holding companies earned a combined NT$49.278 billion in the first seven months of the year, with Taishin Financial Holding Co. taking the title of single-month net profit king, and Fubon Financial Holding Co. holding the title of cumulative net profit king.
13. The income gap between Taiwan's households has reached 6.17 times, setting a new record since 2009.
14. China Times: The prices of wood pulp and transportation have been rising, pushing up costs, and the company will reduce production to 10 months.

15. The 232 tariff measure on unmanned aircraft will take effect on September 3. The Ministry of Economic Affairs has strengthened its efforts to help local companies obtain export qualifications and certifications, and the 15% tariff rate will bring opportunities for 'transfer orders'.

16. The 115 budget bill has passed the third reading, with a total of NT$6.34 billion allocated for unmanned aircraft. The Ministry of Economic Affairs stated that the industry's output value is expected to exceed NT$40 billion by 2030.
17. SiC demand is strong, and China's large manufacturers have announced plans to double their production capacity, benefiting Taiwan's related supply chain.

18. Sino-American Silicon Products Inc. items.title: 美伊達成協議開放荷姆茲海峽「也沒用」？《巴隆》：恐僅能「短暫」壓低油價
items.title_en: Iran-US Deal on Hormuz Strait May Not Last, Says Bloomberg: Price Relief May Be Short-Lived
paras: 即使美伊最終達成協議，荷姆茲海峽重開所帶來的價格紓緩也可能只是短期現象。真正決定全球能源市場中長期走勢的，仍是供應來源、消費結構，以及中東地緣政治風險能否出現更持久的改變。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，近期市場屢次出現類似情況：美國總統川普在Truth Social發布荷姆茲海峽即將開放的訊息，布蘭特原油價格隨之下跌，但航運並未立即恢復，油價隨後又重新走高。
對美國政府而言，盡快結束這場危機並取得看似成功的結果，顯然具有吸引力。
但事實上，美軍先進彈藥庫存正面臨壓力，而持續轟炸是否能迫使伊朗做出更多讓步，也存在疑問。
與此同時，美國期中選舉將至，戰事與高油價所造成的經濟壓力，都可能成為執政陣營需要面對的問題。
分析指出，若美伊真的達成荷姆茲海峽重新開放航運的協議，並且衛星影像證實船舶已恢復通行，關鍵大宗商品價格有望下降，各國央行也可能因此獲得更多空間，延後原本可能考慮的升息行動。
然而，單純讓航運恢復，恐怕只能提供短暫喘息。
其中一大原因是，從地理位置來看，荷姆茲海峽的通行規則很大程度仍取決於伊朗與阿曼。即使雙方沒有正式建立通行費制度，航運業者也可能為確保貨物安全，私下向伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊相關帳戶支付費用，以保障價值數百倍於此的貨物安全。
但分析人士認為，美國不可能無限期容忍這種模式。
與此同時，伊朗國內強硬派勢力似乎正在增強。儘管外界難以掌握伊朗最高層的決策過程，但伊朗最高領袖上週任命新一批高階官員表明，該國政府似乎仍準備抵抗美國政府的要求。
《巴隆》指出，無論荷姆茲海峽最終能否重新開放，伊朗強硬派都可能繼續要求保留發展核武能力的權利，並主張透過更加活躍的區域代理人，牽制以色列與美國。
因此，分析認為，即便美伊就荷姆茲海峽達成協議，也更像只是為更深層的衝突貼上一塊暫時性的「OK繃」，而非真正解決問題。
若未來川普再次威脅發動大規模軍事攻擊，伊朗就可能重新揚言關閉海峽；而一旦雙方再度發生飛彈攻擊，從石油到氦氣等商品價格也可能再次大幅上漲。
值得注意的是，在金融市場劇烈波動的背後，全球關鍵海運商品的供需結構其實也正在改變。
基於各國都不希望未來再次高度依賴一個早已被視為脆弱的區域穩定局勢，新的輸油管線正陸續興建，替代供應商也持續擴大產量，而美國、日本與中國的大量石油儲備，則有助於緩衝供應轉型期間的衝擊。
報導指出，隨著時間改變，生產與消費層面的這些基本面變化，將為這些對全球至關重要的商品建立新的價格均衡。
不過，就目前而言，即使最終達成協議並帶來價格上的紓緩，這種利多效應恐怕也不會持續太久。
paras_en: Even if the US and Iran ultimately reach an agreement, the price relief brought by the reopening of the Hormuz Strait may be a short-term phenomenon. The long-term trend of the global energy market will still be determined by the supply source, consumption structure, and the persistence of Middle East geopolitical risks.

According to a Bloomberg report, the market has seen similar situations in recent times: US President Trump announced on Truth Social that the Hormuz Strait would reopen, causing Brent crude oil prices to drop, but shipping did not immediately resume, and oil prices rebounded.
For the US government, ending the crisis quickly and achieving a seemingly successful outcome is clearly attractive.
However, the US military's advanced ammunition stockpiles are under pressure, and the question remains whether continued bombing will force Iran to make further concessions.
Meanwhile, the US midterm elections are approaching, and the war and high oil prices caused by the economic pressure may become issues that the ruling party needs to face.

Analysts point out that if the US and Iran really reach an agreement to reopen the Hormuz Strait and satellite images confirm that ships have resumed navigation, key commodities prices may decline, and central banks may have more room to delay interest rate hikes.
However, simply allowing shipping to resume may only provide a temporary respite.

One of the main reasons is that, from a geographical perspective, the rules of navigation in the Hormuz Strait are still largely dependent on Iran and Oman, even if they have not formally established a toll system. Shipping companies may privately pay fees to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps to ensure the safety of goods worth hundreds of times more.
However, analysts believe that the US cannot tolerate this pattern indefinitely.

Meanwhile, hardline forces in Iran seem to be gaining strength. Although it is difficult for outsiders to grasp the decision-making process of Iran's top leaders, the appointment of new high-ranking officials by Iran's Supreme Leader last week suggests that the country's government is still prepared to resist US government demands.

Bloomberg notes that, regardless of whether the Hormuz Strait is eventually reopened, Iran's hardliners may continue to demand the right to develop nuclear weapons and advocate for more active regional proxies to deter Israel and the US.
Therefore, analysts believe that even if the US and Iran reach an agreement on the Hormuz Strait, it is more like a temporary 'OK band-aid' for a deeper conflict rather than a real solution.

If Trump threatens to launch a large-scale military attack again in the future, Iran may reiterate its threat to close the Strait; and if the two sides engage in another missile attack, commodity prices for oil, helium, and other goods may surge again.
It is worth noting that behind the financial market's wild fluctuations, the global supply and demand structure of key shipping commodities is actually changing.

Based on the fact that no country wants to rely heavily on a region that has already been considered fragile, new oil pipelines are being built, and alternative suppliers are continuously increasing production, while the US, Japan, and China's massive oil reserves are helping to cushion the impact of supply transformation.
The report points out that as time changes, these basic changes in production and consumption will establish a new price equilibrium for these critical commodities.
However, for now, even if an agreement is reached and brings price relief, this positive effect may not last for too long.

items.title: 美銀曝最優「AI泡沫交易」：建議同時做多「傲慢」與「偏見」
paras: 在人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮持續之際，美銀證券首席策略師Michael Hartnett認為，當前市場的最佳交易策略並非單押AI，而是同時做多「傲慢」（AI科技龍頭）與「偏見」（遭市場冷落的資產），藉此掌握名目GDP泡沫進入最後階段時可能出現的雙向行情。
美銀最新報告顯示，美銀牛熊指標上週由9.7小幅降至9.3，仍處於極度看多區間，但「賣出」訊號持續有效。
與此同時，近期資金流向出現明顯分化，科技股遭遇7週來最大單週資金流出，黃金則吸引今年1月以來最大單週資金流入；大宗商品今年以來總報酬率達58.9%，比特幣則下跌近28%。
美銀指出，現在市場仍相信「不要買債券、不要押美元、繼續買AI」，因為AI是最強成長主題，而且市場認為政策制定者不會輕易讓股市崩盤。
但該行提醒，未來如果美債殖利率繼續飆升、選民對生活成本更加不滿，或市場多頭持倉過度集中，都可能讓AI牛市開始失去上行動能。

AI「傲慢」搭配資產「偏見」　美銀提出雙向布局策略

Hartnett認為，從過往資產泡沫經驗來看，最佳的泡沫交易方式，是同時做多代表AI科技本身的「傲慢」，以及市場長期冷落、可能在名目GDP最終衝頂階段受惠的「偏見」資產。
美銀援引歷史案例指出，1999年網路泡沫以及2007至2008年次貸危機期間，都曾出現被市場忽視的資產在主導泡沫接近頂峰前，受惠於資金外溢的情況。
以目前市場環境來看，美銀認為「消費類股」最可能重現這種走勢。
另一方面，美銀建議放空AI相關債券，因為AI資本支出規模已超過1兆美元，加上企業淨現金流為負，未來可能面臨大量發債需求。
美銀指出，自5月26日牛熊指標首次出現賣出訊號以來，標普500指數仍累計上漲4%，MSCI全球指數也上漲3%。
該行提醒，市場持倉過度集中可能打亂牛市節奏，但真正要終結多頭行情，需要三項條件同時出現，包括持倉過度集中、企業獲利預期過於樂觀，以及政策轉向緊縮。
不過，目前這三項因素尚未同時成立。
從歷史表現來看，美銀牛熊指標成立以來共出現17次賣出訊號，全球股市在訊號出現後2至3個月平均下跌2%至3%，命中率約60%，最大回撤幅度則介於15%至20%。

黃金、大宗商品吸金　科技股出現7週最大流出

值得注意的是，近期資金流向進一步反映市場偏好的轉變。
上週，黃金基金單週淨流入63億美元，創今年1月以來最大單週流入；大宗商品今年以來總報酬率達58.9%，在各類資產中居首，其中原油今年以來上漲43%。
相較之下，科技基金上週淨流出12億美元，創7週以來最大單週流出。歐洲股票基金則吸引12億美元淨流入，創今年2月以來最大流入規模；南韓股票基金也連續第7週出現資金淨流入。
固定收益市場同樣出現資金回流。投資級債券單週吸引106億美元，創5週來最高；新興市場債券則流入14億美元，創7週來最高。現金類資產單週吸金254億美元。

美銀私人客戶股票配置創新高　現金比重降至紀錄低點

美銀私人客戶數據顯示，目前管理資產規模達4.7兆美元，其中股票配置比重升至66.4%，創歷史新高；債券配置降至17%，為2022年3月以來最低；現金配置則降至9.4%，創有紀錄以來最低水準。此外，股票單週淨流入規模也創2022年9月以來最大。
債券配置方面，私人客戶正略微拉長持有期限。今年以來，2年至10年期美國國債配置增加15%，而期限短於1年的國庫券配置則自去年11月以來減少逾30%。不過，30年期長債仍未受到青睞。
過去4週，私人客戶透過ETF買進日本債券、市政債券及抗通膨債券，同時減持新興市場債務、公用事業與金融類股ETF。
美銀同時警告，美國國家債務即將突破40兆美元，預估到2029年7月可能達到50兆美元。
過去12個月，美國聯邦政府利息支出已達1.4兆美元，在5年期美債殖利率降至3.25%以下之前，相關成本仍將持續增加。
與此同時，美國30年期國債以5.126%的殖利率完成發行，創25年來最高水準，但美股當天仍同步創下歷史新高，顯示市場「避開債券」的交易邏輯仍然有效。
值得注意的是，儘管2026年整體殖利率走高，REITs、小型股、生技股及區域銀行等過去受到冷落、對利率較敏感的資產近期反而開始跑贏大盤。
美銀認為，這可能反映市場已提前押注殖利率見頂。
報告認為，美日近期的匯率干預已向市場釋放訊號，顯示美國政府不希望10年期美債殖利率突破5%。
策略師預期，核心CPI在美國期中選舉前可降至2.1%至2.6%，屆時聯準會（Fed）主席華許（Kevin Warsh）可能透過Jackson Hole演說及9月利率會議釋放「任務完成」的訊號，再配合日本央行升息，進一步限制美債殖利率的上行空間。

黃金與香港地產成「避美元」交易選項

在「避開美元」的布局上，美銀提出兩項交易方向。
首先是做多黃金，將黃金視為因應美元貶值、債券市場崩跌及資產通膨的對沖工具，而近期黃金基金大幅吸金也反映市場對此交易的需求。
另一項策略則是布局香港房地產。美銀以「買進被羞辱的資產、賣出傲慢資產」概括這項交易邏輯。恒生地產指數目前處於約30年前的水準，估值約為12倍本益比。
美銀認為，亞洲正進入過去40年來第3輪長期多頭行情，主要由日本、南韓科技產業與中國AI共同推動。
與此同時，香港則可能受惠於杜拜的地緣政治吸引力與新加坡的稅務優勢相對減弱。

美國期中選舉成AI牛市關鍵政治變數

美銀將11月3日美國期中選舉視為影響市場後續走勢的重要事件。報告指出，如果共和黨守住參議院，且德州州長Greg Abbott成功連任，AI領軍的風險資產行情可能在2027年進一步加速。
反之，如果民主黨在11月取得參議院控制權，或拿下德州州長席位，股市、美元與債券殖利率可能在年底前出現超過10%的跌幅。
其中，德州州長選舉被美銀視為「負擔能力」與「AI資料中心」政策方向之間的選擇。
目前德州已有335座資料中心，另有247座正在規劃興建。Abbott近期宣布暫停資料中心擴張，反映選民對能源電網穩定性與生活成本的疑慮。
此外，美銀也關注後續幾項重要政策時程，包括：

8月28日聯準會主席華許在Jackson Hole的演講、
9月16日聯準會利率會議，
以及9月18日日本央行會議。


市場目前對聯準會升息的機率估計為35%，日本央行升息機率則為74%。

items.title: 美伊緊張續升溫！伊朗議會通過反滲透法案 接受美以「敵對媒體」採訪最終判兩年
items.title_en: Iran Tensions Escalate: Parliament Passes Anti-Spying Law, Accepts US, Israel 'Enemy Media' Interviews, Faces 2-Year Sentence
paras: 伊朗議會週日(16日)以183票贊成通過一項反滲透法案，將接受美國、以色列或其資助媒體的採訪與相關通訊往來定為刑事犯罪，違者處6個月至2年監禁。 法案尚待憲法監護委員會審查始生效。
根據這項最新法案，受管制對象涵蓋美、以媒體及受其資助機構；與其他外媒採訪須事前通報情報部，與外國使館、組織未經外交部書面許可接觸者，處罰款並剝奪部分社會權利。
新法案另加重「受外國人指導監督的經濟犯罪」刑責，禁止未經批准向外人提供資訊，限制與非認可外國機構科學合作，而若政策或立法建議受外國情報機構指示、損及伊朗安全或獨立，最高可判30年監禁，由革命法院審理。
伊朗此舉延續去年跟以色列12天戰爭後的嚴打路線。本月伊朗攝影記者雅爾達·莫艾里即依類似條文被判15年，罪狀包括接受「敵對媒體」採訪、向美以兩國有關的組織提供照片。
分析人士指出，新法填補反滲透空白的同時，也把外媒採訪、學術交流與經濟活動進一步納入國安管轄，外界憂心記者與學界風險升高。
paras_en: Iran's parliament passed an anti-spying law on Sunday (16th) with 183 votes in favor, making it a criminal offense to accept interviews or related communications with US, Israeli, or media funded by them, punishable by 6 months to 2 years in prison. The law still needs to be reviewed by the Constitutional Supervision Committee before it takes effect.

According to the new law, the regulated subjects include US, Israeli media, and organizations funded by them; interviews with other foreign media must be reported in advance to the intelligence department, and contact with foreign embassies, organizations without written permission from the Foreign Ministry will be fined and have some social rights revoked.

The new law also increases the punishment for 'economic crimes guided and supervised by foreigners' and prohibits providing information to foreigners without permission, restricts scientific cooperation with unapproved foreign organizations, and if a policy or legislative proposal is directed by foreign intelligence agencies, harms Iran's security or independence, the maximum sentence can be 30 years in prison, tried by the Revolutionary Court.

Iran's move continues the tough line taken after the 12-day war with Israel last year. This month, Iranian photographer Yalda Moallemi was sentenced to 15 years under similar provisions, charged with accepting interviews from 'enemy media' and providing photos to organizations related to the US and Israel.

Analysts point out that the new law fills the gap in anti-spying laws while also bringing foreign media interviews, academic exchanges, and economic activities under national security control, causing concern among journalists and academics that the risks will increase.

items.title: 〈走進中國〉衝上熱搜！銀行能辦結婚證了！
paras: 近日「銀行能辦結婚證了」衝上微博熱搜，引發中國網友關注。
據天津河西民政官方公眾號消息，近日河西區東海婚姻登記處正式揭牌啟用。該登記處坐落在郵儲銀行(01658-HK) 天津泗水道支行愛情主題銀行內，該行成為中國首家在銀行網點落戶的婚姻登記處。
該登記處僅受理中國居民結婚登記業務，同步提供免費頒證儀式、移風易俗宣傳等。目前河西區建立了「區級主大廳+特色登記點」的服務布局，可滿足民眾就近辦事、個性化領證需求。
辦公時間為每周三、周四 9:00～11:30（法定節假日除外；熱門登記日期以河西區民政局公告為準）。
據《每日經濟新聞》報導，郵儲銀行泗水道支行工作人員表示，在銀行網點預約登記，辦理速度會比在民政局稍快，並且可以獲得印有新人照片卡面的專屬定制銀行卡。
此外，新人在辦理完結婚登記後，銀行也可直接提供新婚家庭金融規劃等金融服務。
值得注意的是，郵儲銀行天津泗水道支行愛情主題銀行試點結婚證領取業務，並不意味著銀行獲得結婚證頒發權‌，實際上是‌與民政局合作設立「婚姻登記延伸點」‌，由民政人員駐點發證，銀行僅提供場地與場景服務。‌‌
其實，在去年5月婚姻登記實施「全國通辦」後，不少城市、景區開始打造「領證新地標」，發展結婚登記旅遊。還有地方民政部門入駐音樂節，提供現場結婚登記服務。新疆烏魯木齊、四川成都、浙江寧波等地曾在音樂節舉辦期間引導辦理婚姻登記的類似案例。
作為全國首家能夠辦理婚姻登記的銀行，郵儲銀行天津泗水道支行此次試點引發網友熱議。一部分網友建議，銀行回歸主業；但也有網友表示，這是多元化業務的體現。
《界面新聞》指出，除了結婚證業務試點外，郵儲銀行還曾試點駕駛證到期換取業務。
今年6月，上海徐匯發布消息，稱靠近地鐵12號線虹漕路站口的郵儲銀行網點開通了駕駛證期滿換證業務，藉助現場自助設備，一站式完成辦理，同時駕駛者可以選擇駕駛證寄送。
以往駕駛證期滿換證民眾需要專門抽空前往車管所，對節奏緊湊的上班族、日常出行不便的居民來說，費時費力。
郵儲銀行南通市分行還曾推出「蘇超+文旅」主題網點，富滇銀行普洱分行曾推出咖啡主題銀行，越來越多的銀行正把線下網點改造成一個個「不像銀行」的生活空間。
表面看，這是銀行「不務正業」，背後卻是銀行業在數位化浪潮下的一場集體自救，即在線下客流量下降的情況下，通過這些舉措增加高頻客流。
目前郵儲銀行業績比較穩定。郵儲銀行第一季營業收入為人民幣961.62億元，較去年同期增長7.6%，歸屬於銀行股東的淨利潤為237.26億元，成長1.9%。

items.title: 大摩示警：「2風險」恐推升通膨！Fed或迎新挑戰
paras: 美國通膨近期呈現降溫跡象，但宏觀經濟環境中仍潛藏一些力量，可能促使聯準會（Fed）將利率維持在較高水準更長時間。
根據《Business insider》報導，摩根士丹利首席美國經濟學家Michael T. Gapen週五在給客戶的報告中表示，核心消費者物價指數（CPI）數據顯示，通膨趨勢正在消退。
在他的團隊看來，這可能為聯準會保持耐心創造條件；聯準會在7月會議決定維持利率不變後，沒有必要急於採取利率行動。
不過，摩根士丹利的通膨預測建立在兩項重要假設上：

第一，近期供給面衝擊能夠完全消退，且不會出現新的供應衝擊；
第二，AI相關需求不會帶來顯著的價格壓力，包括記憶體與軟體價格上漲的直接影響，以及強勁需求帶動市場信心後產生的間接效應。


Gapen坦言，上述任何一項甚至兩項假設都有可能出錯，因此目前存在兩大通膨風險，分別是能源衝擊與AI熱潮。
其中，能源市場的變化已經影響美國通膨降溫速度。美國與伊朗的戰事導致全球能源流動受到歷史性干擾，美國家庭也承受相關成本。
Gapen指出，近期美伊關係再次升溫後，現貨與期貨能源價格均明顯上漲，使市場重新擔憂通膨壓力。
他表示，這項變化也逆轉了兩國簽署備忘錄後油價短暫下滑的趨勢，若能源市場進一步受到衝擊，可能增加聯準會在貨幣政策上的壓力。
除了能源之外，AI基礎建設投資熱潮也是Gapen關注的另一項風險。他與其他銀行業分析人士的看法一致，認為至少目前而言，AI並未成為推動通膨下降的力量。
Gapen指出，AI需求快速增加可能推升部分消費品價格，進而抵銷其他領域的通膨降溫效果。
以蘋果(AAPL-US) 為例，公司已調高部分裝置的價格，執行長庫克（Tim Cook）將此歸因於AI產業需求大增所造成的記憶體容量短缺。
在關稅影響方面，Gapen認為，關稅成本轉嫁大致已經完成，核心商品通膨將逐步接近「解放日」（Liberation Day）前的趨勢。
不過，他並不預期價格會完全回到原先水準，原因在於AI相關需求可能在未來幾季持續對電子產品價格形成上行壓力。

items.title: SiC需求強勁 中國大廠宣布產能倍增、台廠同步受惠
items.title_en: Strong SiC Demand, Chinese Giant Announces Doubling Capacity, Taiwanese Firms Benefit Simultaneously
paras: 新一代AI伺服器將導入800V HVDC供電架構，帶動碳化矽(SiC)重要性快速提升，近期市場除傳出SiC報價調漲，也出現新一輪擴產訊號，中國大廠宣布產能目標倍增，台灣相關供應鏈也同步受惠，包括環球晶(6488-TW)、合晶(6182-TW)以及廣運(6125-TW)集團旗下盛新材料，SiC相關訂單與營運動能可望進一步增強。
值得注意的是，此波SiC產業景氣反轉，再度由中國業者率先吹響漲價號角，與過去一年成熟製程、功率元件的漲價路徑高度相似，也讓外界密切關注SiC市場。
中國在成熟製程、功率元件等領域，受惠龐大內需市場與供應鏈支撐，對於供需變化往往是「春江水暖鴨先知」，當產能利用率開始回升，過去激烈的殺價競爭逐步收斂後，通常會同步啟動漲價，而漲價效應也進一步向海外市場擴散。
以成熟製程為例，中國晶圓代工廠自去年下半年率先調升成熟製程報價，隨後市場供需逐步改善，台灣晶圓代工業者今年初陸續跟進；功率元件也自今年初由國際IDM與部分中國業者率先啟動漲價，台灣業者再接棒跟進，帶動功率半導體迎向健康循環。
如今，相同劇本開始在SiC市場浮現。據了解，隨AI伺服器供電架構升級，SiC在電力轉換系統中的重要性明顯提升，尤其在固態變壓器(SST)中，SiC成本占比已達40%，成為關鍵零組件之一，也帶動中國主要SiC供應商近期產能利用率快速攀升。
中國指標IDM廠芯聯集成(688469-CN)目前稼動率已滿載，更在上個月全面調漲報價15%至25%，為因應客戶訂單強勁成長，公司也宣布擴充8吋碳化矽產能，從每月7,000片擴充至15,000片，目標產能要翻倍成長。
從調漲報價到啟動擴產，顯示過去兩年因中國大舉擴充供給、價格競爭激烈而承壓的SiC市場，供需結構正出現明顯轉折。業界看好，若後續需求持續增溫，此波中國率先啟動的漲價潮，也有機會依循過去成熟製程與功率元件的發展軌跡，逐步向全球市場擴散。
台廠方面，環球晶與合晶近年持續深化SiC布局。環球晶表示，近期確實觀察到SiC訂單動能較過去改善，部分應用需求開始回溫，價格也有機會較前兩年低點進一步改善，顯示產業供需已明顯改善。
除既有功率半導體應用外，環球晶與合晶也同步拓展12吋SiC新興市場，包括散熱及先進封裝等領域，目前兩家公司相關產品皆已進入送樣階段。環球晶指出，未來將依客戶需求及認證進度，審慎推動後續產能規劃。
paras_en: The next‑generation AI servers will adopt an 800V HVDC power architecture, rapidly boosting the importance of silicon carbide (SiC). Recently the market has not only heard rumors of SiC price hikes but also seen a new wave of capacity expansion signals, with a major Chinese manufacturer announcing a goal to double its output. Taiwanese supply‑chain players are also set to benefit, including GlobalWafers (6488‑TW), Hoshine (6182‑TW) and the Shengxin Materials unit of the Guangyun (6125‑TW) group, as SiC‑related orders and operating momentum are expected to strengthen further.

It is noteworthy that this wave of a turnaround in the SiC industry is once again being led by Chinese firms sounding the price‑increase alarm, a pattern highly similar to the price‑rise trajectory for mature‑process and power devices over the past year, drawing close attention to the SiC market.

In China’s mature‑process and power‑device sectors, the huge domestic demand and supply‑chain support make the market very responsive—when capacity utilization begins to rise and the previously fierce price‑cut competition eases, price hikes are typically launched, and the price‑increase effect then spreads to overseas markets.

For example, in mature processes, Chinese wafer foundries were the first to raise prices in the second half of last year, after which market supply‑demand gradually improved and Taiwanese wafer foundries followed suit early this year; power devices also saw price hikes initiated by international IDMs and some Chinese firms at the start of the year, with Taiwanese firms subsequently joining in, driving power semiconductors into a healthy cycle.

Now the same script is emerging in the SiC market. With AI server power‑architecture upgrades, SiC’s importance in power‑conversion systems has risen sharply, especially in solid‑state transformers (SST) where SiC accounts for about 40% of cost, becoming a key component and pushing utilization rates of China’s main SiC suppliers up rapidly.

Chinese flagship IDM XinLian Integrated (688469‑CN) is now operating at full capacity and last month raised its prices across the board by 15%‑25%. To meet strong order growth, the company also announced an expansion of its 8‑inch SiC capacity from 7,000 wafers per month to 15,000, aiming to double output.

The move from price hikes to capacity expansion shows that the SiC market, which has been under pressure for two years due to China’s massive supply expansion and intense price competition, is undergoing a clear supply‑demand shift. Industry observers are optimistic that if demand continues to warm, this China‑led price‑rise wave could follow the past development path of mature processes and power devices and gradually spread globally.

On the Taiwanese side, GlobalWafers and Hoshine have been deepening their SiC footprints in recent years. GlobalWafers said it has recently observed improved SiC order momentum compared with the past, with some application demand picking up and prices potentially improving beyond the lows of the previous two years, indicating a clear supply‑demand improvement in the industry.

Beyond existing power‑semiconductor applications, both GlobalWafers and Hoshine are also expanding into the emerging 12‑inch SiC market, including thermal management and advanced packaging fields. Both companies have now entered the sample‑delivery stage for related products, and GlobalWafers noted that future capacity planning will be pursued cautiously based on customer demand and certification progress.

items.title: 樺漢今年獲利估高成長 收購Kontron效益明顯顯現
items.title_en: Wistron NeWeb Corp Expects High Growth in Profit This Year as Benefits from Kontron Acquisition Become Evident
paras: 工業電腦大廠樺漢(6414-TW)董事長朱復銓表示，預期今年營收、毛利、營業利益、以及淨利皆呈現高成長，公開收購 Kontron 完成後持股將達約 49.4%，雙方將進一步深化整合，預期從明年開始產生營收與成本綜效。
朱復銓表示，目前在手訂單超過 2,550 億元，三大事業持續成長，其中高毛利智慧軟體與方案將帶動整體獲利體質持續改善；另外智慧工廠與廠務受惠於半導體廠務需求推動高科技設備與自動化系統營收成長；工業物聯網業務則持續由零售與金融智慧化需求推動營收增長。
實體 AI（Physical AI）應用持續落地至全球智慧製造、智慧金融、零售、邊緣運算系統等場景，推動工控物聯網以及智慧軟體與方案等業務成長，各大應用別實體 AI 落地商業化，將優化產品組合與獲利；另外，歐美智慧零售滲透率持續反映於樺漢營收表現上。
同時，樺漢持續新事業佈局推進，涵蓋能源裝置、設備與建築智慧管理、ESG 節能減碳及 AI 技術應用等領域，並持續透過策略聯盟與併購，擴大智慧物聯網（AIoT）的應用場景。
朱復銓表示，將透過營運、資產運用效率、與資本結構管理等手段提升長期股東權益報酬率 (ROE)，目標在 2030 年達到 20% ROE 里程碑，並提供股東 30%年化總股東報酬率 (TSR)。
paras_en: Chairman Zhu Fuquan of industrial computer giant Wistron NeWeb Corp (6414‑TW) said the company expects revenue, gross profit, operating profit and net profit to all show strong growth this year, and that after the public acquisition of Kontron its stake will reach about 49.4%. The two sides will deepen integration and expect revenue and cost synergies to start materialising from next year.

Zhu said the company currently has orders exceeding NT$255 billion, with its three main businesses continuing to grow. High‑margin smart software and solutions will drive ongoing improvement in overall profitability; smart factories and plant services will benefit from semiconductor plant demand, boosting revenue for high‑tech equipment and automation systems; and the industrial IoT business will keep growing on the back of retail and financial intelligence needs.

Physical AI applications are increasingly being deployed worldwide in smart manufacturing, smart finance, retail and edge‑computing scenarios, driving growth in industrial IoT as well as smart software and solutions. Commercialisation of physical AI across major use cases will optimise the product mix and profitability, while the penetration of smart retail in Europe and the United States continues to be reflected in Wistron NeWeb’s revenue performance.

At the same time, Wistron NeWeb continues to advance new‑business initiatives covering energy devices, equipment and intelligent building management, ESG energy‑saving and carbon‑reduction, and AI technology applications, and will keep expanding AIoT use cases through strategic alliances and acquisitions.

Zhu said the company will improve long‑term shareholder return on equity (ROE) through better operations, asset utilisation and capital‑structure management, targeting a 20% ROE milestone by 2030 and delivering a 30% annual total shareholder return (TSR) to shareholders.

items.title: 〈台股風向球〉8月來反彈2700點 4萬6關前籌碼面轉強有助驚驚漲格局
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market: A Rebound of 2,700 Points in August, Stronger Chipmaking and Technical Indicators
paras: 台股加權指數上周續彈1585點，即將挑戰站穩46000點上，三大法人同步買超，呈現籌碼面和技術面均偏多的態勢，再加上新台幣升破32元價位在望，台股交易員認為，台股多頭匯集，惟8月以來已反彈2691點，漲多後逢上檔層層反壓需要時間，預料進入財報空窗期後透過資金面的回補，先呈現驚驚漲格局為優。

外資上周在集中市場大舉買超2061.36億元，投信也續買145.96億元，自營含避險買超430.29億元； 其中，外資主要買超力積電(6770-TW)達31.6萬張、主動統一升級50(00403A-TW)達24萬張、主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)19.7萬張、華新(1605-TW)11萬張、仁寶(2324-TW)和元大台灣50(0050-TW)均逾10萬張，華邦電(2344-TW)9.4萬張、主動凱基台灣(00407A-TW)達8.6萬張、中鋼(2002-TW)和南亞科(2408-TW)在6.3萬張上。
台股交易員認為，美國聯準會升息壓力大幅緩解，外資期貨淨空單由前一周的87911口降至85179口，且外資也開始積極回補現貨，搭配新台幣升值、資金回流，短線台股雖面臨上方多層反壓，未來一周多方仍有望逐步層層突破。
永豐投顧說明， 從美股季報和各大公司釋出訊息來看，各大CSP業者雖面對現金流下降、轉負的窘境，對AI投資的腳步並未動搖，甚至要加大力度，破除市場懷疑論，台股股價趨勢不變。
永豐投顧認為，投資人的信心逐漸恢復並反映到盤面，跌深的股票由於籌碼因素，反而在反彈過程有更大空間，短線機會可以把握，惟整體進入壓力圈，容易波動。
也有法人提醒，考量加權指數日 KD 進入過熱區，K 值高達 93.03，另觀察本波從最高點拉回 8834 點，透過黃金分割率 0.809強勢反彈推算，滿足點約落在 46500點左右，短期多方上攻略見壓力，預料將來回測試逐漸墊高支撐。
paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE) weighted index rose by 1,585 points last week and is about to challenge the 46,000-point mark. The three major institutional investors simultaneously bought more than they sold, presenting a strong chipmaking and technical indicator. With the New Taiwan dollar expected to break through the 32-yuan price level, traders believe that the TWSE has gathered momentum, but after rebounding by 2,691 points since August, it needs time to overcome the pressure from the upper levels after the surge.

Foreign investors bought a net value of NT$206.136 billion in the concentrated market last week, while securities investment trust companies bought NT$14.596 billion and dealers bought NT$43.029 billion. Foreign investors mainly bought Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) (6770-TW) with 316,000 shares, Fubon Unified Growth Fund (00403A-TW) with 240,000 shares, Fubon Unified Taiwan Growth Fund (00981A-TW) with 197,000 shares, and other stocks.

Traders believe that the pressure of the US Federal Reserve's interest rate hike has eased significantly, and foreign investors' net short positions in futures have decreased from 87,911 to 85,179. Foreign investors have also started to actively replenish their stocks, coupled with the appreciation of the New Taiwan dollar and the return of funds. Although the TWSE is facing multiple layers of resistance in the short term, the bulls are still expected to break through gradually in the next week.

According to Yuanta Investment Consulting, despite the decline in cash flow and the negative situation faced by major CSP companies, they have not changed their investment plans in AI and are even increasing their investment. This has dispelled market doubts, and the trend of the TWSE's stock prices remains unchanged.

Yuanta Investment Consulting believes that investors' confidence is gradually recovering and is reflected in the market. Stocks that have fallen deeply have more room for rebound due to chipmaking factors, and short-term opportunities can be grasped. However, the overall market is entering a pressure zone and is easily fluctuating.

Some institutional investors have reminded that considering the daily KD index of the weighted index has entered the overbought zone, with a K value of 93.03, and observing the pullback from the highest point to 8,834 points, the strong rebound calculated through the golden ratio of 0.809 is around 46,500 points. The short-term bull market is expected to face pressure, and it is expected to fluctuate and gradually build a higher support level.

items.title: 台股修復行情！6檔主動ETF扮反彈急先鋒 今年漲幅重回7-8成
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Rebounds! 6 Active ETFs Lead the Charge with 7-8% Growth
paras: 經歷 7 月份科技股評價修正，8 月以來台股飆出大漲修復行情，大盤今年漲幅已回到60%水準，自7月底低檔反彈達17%。CMoney統計，今年主動台股ETF漲幅最強前十名標的，6檔漲幅回到70%以上，像是主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)、主動復華未來50(00991A-TW)、主動群益科技創新(00992A-TW)等熱門標的，值得留意的是，今年1月才推出的主動第一金台股優(00994A-TW)、主動中信台灣卓越(00995A-TW)也榜上有名，這些領漲標的自7月30日台股低點以來表現犀利，漲幅高達20%至30%，大幅領先大盤。
台股近日反彈突破半年線、季線，14日呈現高檔區間震盪，主動第一金台股優 ETF 經理人張正中說明，預料台股後市可望呈現高檔震盪，主要由於高檔套牢區壓力大，需要時間反覆測試，才能挑戰歷史高點48,200點，不過，已有部分強勢個股已率先站上歷史高點，他觀察，7月大盤最大跌幅為17%，8月這波反彈也高達17%，這是多頭行情中的合理上下波動幅度，中期而言，台股仍將現多頭格局的震盪行情。
這波股價修正也看到散戶投資人積極加碼台股ETF，張正中說明，散戶積極買進，加上外資由賣轉買，籌碼面可望回復穩定，此外，投機買盤融資餘額也在7月大盤修正中，快速去化一成以上水準，回到目前5,500億元附近，過去一周大盤相較7月至8月初的急漲急跌走勢回穩，這段於台股後市良性上攻相對有利。
張正中強調，台股第二季財報公布與法說展望中，科技各次產業獲利上修比例遠於下修，其中，AI族群獲利優於預期，未來可望透過外溢效應推升非AI族群基本面同步改善，提供台股在高檔區間震盪再次上攻的實質動能。
※免責聲明：文中所提的個股、基金、期貨商品內容僅供參考，並非投資建議，投資人應獨立判斷，審慎評估風險，自負盈虧。
paras_en: After a 7-month correction in tech stocks, the Taiwan stock market has seen a sharp rebound since August, with the overall market's year-to-date growth returning to 60%. The market has gained 17% since the end of July. According to CMoney's statistics, the top 10 active Taiwan stock ETFs with the highest year-to-date growth include 6 funds that have surpassed 70% growth, such as active Uni-Taiwan Growth (00981A-TW), active Fubon Future 50 (00991A-TW), and active GroupY Tech Innovation (00992A-TW). Notably, the newly launched active First Financial Taiwan Select (00994A-TW) and active Credit Suisse Taiwan Excellence (00995A-TW) have also made the list, with these leading stocks gaining 20-30% since the market's low point on July 30, significantly outperforming the overall market.

The Taiwan stock market has recently broken through its half-year and quarterly lines, with a high-range oscillation on the 14th. Active First Financial Taiwan Select ETF manager Zhang Zhengzhong said that the market is expected to continue its high-range oscillation, mainly due to the high-range lock-in pressure, which will take time to test and challenge the historical high point of 48,200. However, some strong individual stocks have already reached their historical highs. He observed that the market's largest decline in July was 17%, and the current rebound has also reached 17%, which is a reasonable fluctuation range in a bull market. In the medium term, the market will continue to experience a bull market's oscillation.

This round of stock price correction has also seen individual investors actively adding to their Taiwan stock ETF holdings, with Zhang Zhengzhong saying that individual investors have been actively buying, and foreign investors have switched from selling to buying, which is expected to stabilize the market's sentiment. Additionally, the margin financing balance has also decreased by over 10% since the market's correction in July, returning to around NT$55 billion. In the past week, the market has stabilized compared to the sharp fluctuations in July and early August, which is beneficial for a healthy upward trend in the Taiwan stock market.

Zhang Zhengzhong emphasized that the Taiwan stock market's second-quarter earnings reports and forward-looking statements will be released soon, with the technology sector's earnings upgrades far exceeding downgrades. Specifically, the AI sector's earnings have exceeded expectations, and it is expected to drive the non-AI sector's fundamentals to improve through the spillover effect, providing a solid driving force for the Taiwan stock market to rebound again in the high-range zone.

items.title: 華碩伺服器出貨強勁與高階PC占比提升 Q3營運看旺毛利率走俏
items.title_en: ASUS Server Shipments Strong and High-End PC Market Share Increases Q3 Operations Look Promising
paras: PC品牌華碩(2357-TW)在伺服器業務爆發性成長與高階產品比重提升帶動下，第二季毛利率由上一季顯著拉升2.8個百分點至16.5%，法人分析指出，隨著第三季步入傳統旺季，加上伺服器與零組件需求回溫，整體營收動能可望持續擴張。
觀察產品營收結構，華碩第二季系統產品占比為45%，伺服器等基礎設施事業占比大幅拉升至36%，開放平台零組件則占19%，法人評估第三季個人電腦業務營收將季增15%至20%，顯示卡與主機板等零組件業務季增5%至10%，伺服器部門受惠新品效應延續也將實現10%至15%的季增長。
法人指出，雖然上游記憶體價格走揚壓抑整體市場出貨規模，但華碩在電競、創作者及高階機種具備強大市場競爭力，成功將成本轉嫁至終端售價，推升全球個人電腦市占率自2020年的5.8%穩步攀升至今年上半年的7.2%，電競相關產品營收比重更已達40%，成為抵禦市場波動的重要支撐。
在伺服器市場方面，AI終端推論需求持續升溫，企業級運算設備、政府及主權機構出貨顯著增加，推升伺服器出貨呈現倍數增長，加上各大雲端服務供應商持續擴大資料中心基礎設施投資，伺服器業務在整體營收中的占比正持續提高，成為支撐長期營運規模擴大的核心引擎。
展望新世代產品布局，輝達推出整合微軟作業系統的新一代運算平台，華碩預計於第四季推出相關高階機種，法人提到，目前市場預購熱烈，由於具備在地端執行大型語言模型與代理任務的能力，單機平均售價顯著高於傳統機種，預期將於未來數年帶動全新一波個人電腦換機浪潮，進一步優化整體產品結構。
paras_en: ASUS (2357-TW) saw a significant increase in server business growth and high-end product market share, leading to a 2.8 percentage point increase in gross margin to 16.5% in the second quarter. Analysts point out that with the third quarter entering the traditional peak season, combined with the recovery of server and component demand, overall revenue momentum is expected to continue to expand.

Looking at product revenue structure, ASUS' second-quarter system product share was 45%, while server and infrastructure business share surged to 36%, and open platform components accounted for 19%. Analysts estimate that third-quarter personal computer business revenue will increase by 15% to 20%, while graphics card and motherboard businesses will increase by 5% to 10%, and the server department will benefit from new product effects and achieve a 10% to 15% quarterly increase.

Analysts point out that although upstream memory prices have risen, suppressing overall market shipment scale, ASUS has strong market competitiveness in gaming, creator, and high-end products, successfully passing on costs to terminal sales prices, pushing the global personal computer market share from 5.8% in 2020 to 7.2% in the first half of this year. Gaming-related products have a revenue share of 40%, becoming an important support against market fluctuations.

In the server market, AI endpoint inference demand continues to heat up, with enterprise-level computing equipment, government, and sovereign institutions seeing significant increases in shipments, leading to a multiple-fold increase in server shipments. Additionally, major cloud service providers continue to expand data center infrastructure investments, pushing server business to continue to increase its share in overall revenue, becoming a core engine supporting long-term operation scale expansion.

Looking ahead to new-generation product layouts, TSMC is expected to release a new generation of computing platforms integrated with Microsoft operating systems in the fourth quarter, with ASUS planning to release related high-end products. Analysts note that the market is currently seeing strong pre-orders, as the products possess the ability to execute large-scale language models and agent tasks on a single machine, with average selling prices significantly higher than traditional products, expected to drive a new wave of personal computer upgrades in the coming years, further optimizing overall product structure.

items.title: AI持股逾7成！00980A配0.638元年化息率12%創新高 想配息最遲這天上車
items.title_en: AI Holdings Exceed 70%! 00980A Offers 0.638 Yuan Yearly Interest Rate of 12% New High, Hoping to Get Dividends as Soon as Possible
paras: 台股高盤震盪，主動式台股ETF配息再掀話題。AI相關持股高達7成的野村投信旗下主動野村臺灣優選ETF（00980A-TW）公告第二階段收益分配，每受益權單位預計配發0.638元，本次配息金額再創成立以來新高，單季配息率約3%，換算年化配息率約12%，除息交易日為8月18日，投資人若想參與本次配息，最晚須在明(17) 日前買進並持有，股息預計於9月11日發放。
繼7月全球主要市場股災，近期股市投資氣氛轉佳，主因美股第二季財報表現普遍優於市場預期，加上台股進入法說會旺季，多家科技大廠釋出樂觀展望。同時，美國最新公布的通膨數據符合預期，就業市場也出現降溫跡象，市場對聯準會貨幣政策的擔憂有所緩解，有助風險性資產表現。
對於後市看法，00980A基金經理人游景德指出，近期台股震盪主要來自籌碼整理及市場情緒波動，並非基本面反轉。他認為，目前台股仍有四大利多支撐，包括全球AI投資循環延續、亞洲供應鏈競爭優勢提升、企業獲利持續成長，以及市場籌碼面逐步改善，均有助支撐中長期行情。
其中最受市場關注的仍是AI產業發展。游景德表示，全球科技巨頭持續擴大AI資本支出，Token使用量與GPU算力需求維持成長趨勢，顯示AI應用商業化仍在加速推進。隨著相關投資效益逐漸顯現，台灣AI供應鏈可望持續受惠。
從持股布局來看，00980A目前AI相關部位占比超過七成，涵蓋半導體、IC設計、伺服器零組件及電源管理等產業鏈，主要持股包括台積電、聯發人水科、川湖、台光電與台達電等指標企業。此外，也配置部分金融保險及傳產類股，並透過期貨工具彈性調整投資水位，以提高投資組合靈活度。
市場法人認為，在AI長線趨勢不變、台股進入高檔震盪階段之際，主動式ETF可藉由經理團隊主動調整持股與汰弱留強，掌握產業輪動機會。隨著00980A此次年化配息率衝上12%，加上AI主題持股優勢，後續除息表現值得市場持續關注。
paras_en: Taiwan's stock market experienced a high volatility day, and the active Taiwan stock ETF (00980A-TW) announced the second stage of profit distribution, with each unit expected to distribute 0.638 yuan, setting a new high since its establishment. The dividend rate for this quarter is approximately 3%, and the annualized dividend rate is approximately 12%. The ex-dividend trading day is August 18, and investors who want to participate in this dividend must buy and hold the shares by August 17 at the latest. The dividend is expected to be paid on September 11.

Following the global stock market crash in July, the investment atmosphere in the stock market has improved in recent times, mainly due to the better-than-expected second-quarter earnings reports from US stocks, as well as Taiwan's entry into the peak season of the legislative session, with many technology giants releasing optimistic outlooks. At the same time, the latest inflation data from the US met expectations, and the job market showed signs of cooling down, which helped alleviate concerns about the Federal Reserve's monetary policy, benefiting risk assets.

Regarding the outlook for the market, the manager of the 00980A fund, You Jingde, pointed out that the recent fluctuations in the Taiwan stock market were mainly due to inventory adjustments and market sentiment fluctuations, rather than a reversal of the fundamental situation. He believes that the Taiwan stock market still has four major bullish factors, including the continuation of the global AI investment cycle, the improvement of Asia's supply chain competitiveness, the sustained growth of corporate profits, and the gradual improvement of the market's inventory situation, all of which will help support the medium- to long-term trend.

The most concerned industry in the market is still the AI industry. You Jingde stated that the world's technology giants continue to expand their AI capital expenditures, and the usage of tokens and the demand for GPU computing power remain in a growth trend, indicating that the commercialization of AI applications is still accelerating. As the related investment returns gradually become apparent, Taiwan's AI supply chain is expected to continue to benefit.

From a holding layout perspective, 00980A currently has an AI-related holding ratio of over 70%, covering the semiconductor, IC design, server components, and power management industries, with major holdings including Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, MediaTek, Changeland, Taiwan Green Energy Technology, and Delta Electronics. In addition, it has also allocated some financial insurance and traditional industries, and has adjusted the investment scale through futures tools to improve the flexibility of the investment portfolio.

Market professionals believe that, in the context of the AI long-term trend remaining unchanged and the Taiwan stock market entering the high-volatility stage, active ETFs can take advantage of the manager's team to actively adjust holdings and eliminate weak stocks, seizing the opportunities of industry rotation. With 00980A's year-end dividend rate reaching 12% this time, combined with the advantages of AI-themed holdings, the subsequent dividend performance is worth continued attention from the market.

items.title: 幫你看緊荷包！​​​​​​​期交所祭2大風控新招：夜盤預警17日上線、風險模擬平台升級
items.title_en: Taiwan Futures Exchange Launches Two New Risk Control Measures
paras: 在台股維持高檔震盪、國際市場波動加劇，凸顯衍生性金融商品風險管理的重要性。為協助市場參與者即時掌握風險、提升避險能力，臺灣期貨交易所（期交所）推出兩項重要措施，一方面擴充「期貨交易風險情境模擬平台」功能，新增股票選擇權商品；另一方面，自8月17日起上線「結算會員自設風險警示自動通知服務」，強化夜盤風控機制，透過制度與科技工具雙管齊下，提升市場韌性與穩定度。
期交所表示，為協助交易人更有效評估持有部位風險，已建置線上「期貨交易風險情境模擬平台」，提供投資人免安裝軟體即可透過瀏覽器使用的風控工具。平台目前已涵蓋指數期貨、股票期貨及臺指選擇權等熱門商品，而此次進一步納入股票選擇權，讓交易人能夠以單一平台整合不同商品部位，全面檢視投資組合風險與保證金需求。
根據規劃，交易人可自行建立部位，並設定標的價格、波動度及剩餘天期等不同市場情境，模擬各種行情變化下的預估損益及保證金變化情形。平台並提供Delta、Gamma、Vega及Theta等Greeks風險指標，協助交易人掌握選擇權價格敏感度，適時進行避險調整或風險互抵配置。
隨著股票衍生性商品市場快速成長，期交所此次也將台積電等熱門股票選擇權商品納入平台模擬範圍。投資人可透過情境分析測試標的股價大漲、大跌甚至波動率變化下的部位表現，進一步評估自身風險承受能力與資金運用效率，降低市場劇烈波動帶來的衝擊。
期交所指出，該平台推出以來即以簡便操作及提升風險意識為核心目標，今年度累計瀏覽人次已突破6.5萬，顯示市場對於風險管理工具需求持續升溫。未來也將依市場發展趨勢及使用者需求持續優化功能。
除了協助一般交易人，期交所也同步強化市場後端風控機制。因應近年夜盤交易量持續成長，以及全球金融市場波動幅度增加，期交所自8月17日起推出全新的「結算會員自設風險警示自動通知服務」，進一步升級夜盤風險預警機制。
現行制度下，當結算會員新增委託保證金占超額保證金比率達警示標準時，期交所即透過簡訊及電子郵件通知會員注意。此次新措施除了讓會員可自行縮短通知間隔，提升風險資訊傳遞速度外，也新增「整戶維持率」及「委託保證金增加金額及幅度」兩項關鍵預警指標。
其中，「整戶維持率」可協助會員掌握未平倉部位保證金水位與資金狀況；而「委託保證金增加金額及幅度」則能有效監控短時間內保證金需求急遽上升情況。結算會員可依據經紀或自營業務特性，自行設定警示門檻、通知頻率與接收人員，提升自主風控彈性。
期交所強調，在全球金融市場連動性提高、夜盤交易重要性日益攀升的環境下，透過前端交易風險模擬工具與後端夜盤預警機制同步升級，不僅有助於交易人及結算會員及早辨識風險，也能在市場劇烈波動時及時採取因應措施，共同維護期貨市場安全、穩定與健全發展。
paras_en: As the Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE) continues to maintain a high level of volatility, and international markets experience increased fluctuations, the importance of managing risks associated with derivative financial products has become more apparent. To assist market participants in grasping risks in real-time and enhancing their risk management capabilities, the Taiwan Futures Exchange (TAIFEX) has introduced two key measures. Firstly, it has expanded the functionality of the 'Futures Trading Risk Scenario Simulation Platform' to include stock option products. Secondly, it will launch the 'Settlement Member Self-Set Risk Alert Automatic Notification Service' on August 17, further strengthening its night trading risk control mechanism.

TAIFEX stated that it has built an online 'Futures Trading Risk Scenario Simulation Platform' to assist traders in evaluating the risks associated with their holdings more effectively. The platform, which is accessible through a web browser without the need for software installation, currently covers popular products such as index futures, stock futures, and Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE) index options. This time, it has added stock options to the platform, enabling traders to integrate different products and view their investment portfolio risks and margin requirements in a single platform.

According to the plan, traders can create their own positions and set target prices, volatility, and remaining days to different market scenarios, simulating various market fluctuations and estimated losses and margin changes. The platform also provides Delta, Gamma, Vega, and Theta risk indicators to help traders grasp the sensitivity of option prices and make timely adjustments or risk offsetting arrangements.

As the stock derivative product market has grown rapidly, TAIFEX has also included popular stock option products such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) in the platform's simulation range. Investors can use scenario analysis to test the performance of their positions under various market conditions, such as price surges, price crashes, or changes in volatility, and further evaluate their risk-bearing capacity and capital allocation efficiency, reducing the impact of market volatility.

TAIFEX pointed out that the platform has been launched with the core goal of providing simple operations and enhancing risk awareness. Since its launch, the platform has attracted over 65,000 visitors, demonstrating the market's continued demand for risk management tools. In the future, it will continue to optimize its functions based on market trends and user needs.

In addition to assisting general traders, TAIFEX has also strengthened its back-end risk control mechanism. In response to the continuous growth of night trading volumes and the increasing amplitude of global financial market fluctuations, TAIFEX will launch the 'Settlement Member Self-Set Risk Alert Automatic Notification Service' on August 17, further upgrading its night trading risk warning mechanism.

Under the current system, when a settlement member's margin account exceeds the excess margin ratio, TAIFEX will notify the member via SMS and email. This new measure not only allows members to shorten the notification interval and improve the speed of risk information transmission but also adds two key warning indicators: 'Overall Maintenance Rate' and 'Margin Account Increase Amount and Rate'.

The 'Overall Maintenance Rate' helps members grasp the margin water level and capital situation of their unsettled positions, while the 'Margin Account Increase Amount and Rate' effectively monitors the rapid increase in margin requirements over a short period. Settlement members can set their own warning thresholds, notification frequencies, and recipients based on their brokerage or proprietary business characteristics, enhancing their autonomous risk control flexibility.

TAIFEX emphasized that, in an environment where global financial market interconnectedness is increasing and night trading importance is rising, upgrading both front-end trading risk simulation tools and back-end night trading warning mechanisms will not only help traders and settlement members identify risks early on but also enable them to take timely measures in response to market fluctuations, thereby maintaining the safety, stability, and healthy development of the futures market.

items.title: Anthropic揭Claude Code「省錢6招」！善用快取、/clear降低Token成本
paras: Anthropic近日發布一篇部落格文章，針對開發者使用Claude Code時容易出現的Token浪費問題，整理出6項降低成本的實用技巧。
官方指出，Claude Code的使用成本不只取決於選用哪個模型，也與推理強度、上下文長度及提示快取是否命中密切相關；若缺乏上下文管理，同一項程式開發任務的成本可能出現數倍差距。
Anthropic建議，開發者完成一項任務後應立即使用「/clear」清除對話，避免前一項工作的檔案內容、指令輸出與探索過程持續留在上下文中，並在開始工作時就確定模型與推理強度，減少後續切換造成的快取失效。

Anthropic列6招降低Claude Code成本


在不同任務之間執行「/clear」，避免把之前無關的上下文繼續送到模型，進而減少Token消耗。
開始工作前，先確定好模型和推理強度，因為中途更改其中任何一個，都可能導致提示詞快取失效，進而增加Token成本。
不要只寫出檔名，而是直接用「@」提及文件，使檔案會直接附加到訊息中，省去一次Read調用，並避免Claude再去搜尋檔案。
對輸出冗長的指令加上靜默參數，或把指令交給子代理執行。因為命令輸出會像檔案一樣加入對話，並且在整個會話期間都會保留。
在新會話開始時執行一次「/context」。它會顯示目前載入的內容（例如 CLAUDE.md 和 MCP 工具定義），方便用戶刪除不必要的內容。
暫時離開鍵盤前執行「/compact」。提示詞快取通常一小時後就會過期，而在快取仍然有效時進行對話壓縮，成本要低得多。


Claude Code成本關鍵在Token如何被計算

Anthropic也進一步說明Claude Code背後的Token消耗機制。每次使用者發出指令時，模型首先需要進行「預填充」，讀取系統提示詞、CLAUDE.md、使用者訊息及過往對話等輸入內容；接著進入「解碼」（decode）階段，產生模型回覆、思考內容及工具呼叫等輸出。
兩者的運算方式並不相同。預填充會一次處理輸入內容，而解碼則是逐個Token產生輸出，因此輸出Token的成本高於輸入Token。
模型本身則決定每個Token的價格，而推理強度會影響Token使用量。
Anthropic指出，推理強度越高，模型需要產生的思考Token越多，因此開發者不應在所有任務上都使用最高推理強度，而應根據工作的複雜程度選擇合適的模型與設定。

提示快取成為降低成本的重要工具

在Claude Code的成本結構中，提示快取是另一個關鍵因素。
Claude Code的請求通常會包含相同的前綴，例如系統提示詞、工具定義、CLAUDE.md以及既有對話歷史。如果下一次請求的前綴內容與前一次完全一致，系統可以直接使用先前的計算結果，而不必重新處理全部內容。
Anthropic指出，快取讀取只要正常輸入價的0.1倍，可以直接省掉90%。雖然首次寫入快取需要較高成本，但之後的請求可以持續利用既有快取。
不過，快取並非永久有效，而且必須維持連續匹配。Anthropic列出幾種可能導致快取失效的情況，包括切換模型、改變推理強度、開啟或關閉Fast mode、使用「/compact」重新整理對話、快取逾期，以及長時間後恢復舊會話。
其中，模型與推理強度的切換尤其值得注意。Anthropic指出，不同模型各自擁有獨立快取，因此從一個模型切換到另一個模型後，原本的對話歷史可能需要重新進行預填充；推理強度同樣屬於快取條件之一。
此外，Anthropic也提醒使用者注意「opusplan」模式。由於該模式會在不同階段切換模型，因此進入或離開相關模式都可能造成快取失效，頻繁切換可能增加額外成本。

對話越長，累積成本也越高

即使成功利用快取降低重複處理成本，Anthropic仍提醒，對話本身持續膨脹仍會增加Token使用量。
Claude每讀取一個檔案、執行一次指令，都可能將相關內容加入對話歷史。隨著工作輪數增加，後續請求需要攜帶的上下文也會越來越長。
Claude Code設有機制處理過大的命令輸出：當輸出超過一定長度時，內容會被寫入暫存檔案，而對話中只保留摘要。不過，較短但仍然龐大的輸出仍可能直接留在上下文中。
例如測試工具產生大量測試結果，即使沒有超過系統設定的門檻，這些內容仍可能持續佔據後續對話空間。
因此，Anthropic再次強調，讓命令保持精簡、將大型工作交給子代理，以及適時清除或壓縮對話，都是降低上下文膨脹的重要方式。
除了「/clear」與「/compact」之外，Anthropic也提到「/rewind」。如果最近幾輪對話出現偏離，可以利用「/rewind」移除後續內容，同時保留較早的對話與快取狀態。

AI程式開發開始出現「Token管理」能力

從Anthropic整理的這些技巧可以看出，Claude Code的使用效率已不只是模型能力或程式設計技巧的問題，如何管理上下文、控制輸出、維持快取及選擇適當推理強度，也逐漸成為影響開發成本的重要因素。
對開發者而言，真正需要避免的並非單次使用大量Token，而是在長時間、多輪次的工作流程中，讓無關的上下文不斷累積，並因模型或設定切換導致原本可以重複利用的快取失效。
Anthropic此次公布的6項建議，核心邏輯也相當明確：讓每一次請求只攜帶真正需要的內容、讓能夠快取的內容持續命中，並將不必要的大量輸出隔離在主對話之外。對於高頻率使用Claude Code的開發者而言，這些操作將直接影響相同工作量下的Token消耗。

items.title: 距發表還一個月！電商不怕臨時改模 搶先開賣折疊iPhone殼  配件商打什麼算盤？
items.title_en: Apple's Foldable iPhone Looms, but Accessories Sellers Are Already Racing to Market
paras: 距蘋果首款折疊iPhone與iPhone 18系列正式亮相還有一個月左右，但電商平台上的「配件搶跑」已開跑，不少店家直接以「iPhone Fold」、「iPhone Ultra」為關鍵字上架折疊手機殼，未發布的iPhone 18系列保護殼、鋼化膜也同步現身，部分商品甚至按機型、材質、款式細分完畢。
《每日經濟新聞》報導，當記者以消費者身份詢價，商家多不願透露數據來源，只強調「工廠包數據、按數據開模」「確定可適配」，若日後改模會補發，但一款手機殼從開模、打樣到備庫存，本就牽動整條供應鏈，未發布就量產，本質是場高風險押注。
長期經營蘋果生態配件的業內人士表示，第三方廠商慣例會提前三個月備戰，搶的是新機上市首波「買機必買殼」的窗口，等蘋果發表再開發，黃金流量早已過去。資訊來源則不只靠官方，量產階段供應鏈外溢、機模流出、渲染圖與產業爆料，都足以讓成熟廠商憑尺寸、鏡頭位、按鍵佈局先行開模。
報導指出，今年還多了一個特殊變量，蘋果印度核心代工廠塔塔電子6月遭勒索攻擊，超20萬份、630GB機密文件(含主板圖紙、晶片參數、真機測試片)流入暗網，被稱為蘋果史上最嚴重洩密事件，新德里已介入調查，這讓配件廠能拿到的「公開情報」比往年更紮實。
不過，風險也更高。直板iPhone迭代多年，手機殼廠有經驗累積，折疊螢幕涉及鉸鏈、機身厚度、開合結構與螢幕形態，任一關鍵尺寸變動都可能讓前期開模作廢重來，也就是說折疊款「搶跑」賭注遠大於Pro機種。
知情人士透露，蘋果擬於下月只發表兩款高階Pro與首款折疊 iPhone，2027上半年再把標準版與SE整合發布，形成「Pro 秋發、基礎款春發」的拆分節奏。對配件產業鏈而言，過去一年一次秋季集中備貨，未來可能拆成多個時間窗口，從「一年一站集中搶跑」轉向「長周期、高頻接力」。
搶跑看似只是電商常態，實則映出蘋果保密防線鬆動、供應鏈情報商品化，以及 iPhone 產品節奏重組三股力量交疊。新機還沒露面，圍繞它的千億配件生意，已經先跑完了第一圈。
paras_en: Just a month before Apple's first foldable iPhone and iPhone 18 series are set to debut, e-commerce platforms have already seen a rush of 'accessory pre-sales.' Many sellers have listed foldable phone cases under keywords like 'iPhone Fold' and 'iPhone Ultra,' with some even offering cases for the yet-to-be-released iPhone 18 series and screen protectors.

According to a report by the Daily Economic News, when reporters inquired about prices as consumers, many sellers refused to disclose their data sources, only stating that they had 'factory data' and 'opened molds based on data.' If the design were to change later, they would issue a recall, but one phone case from mold opening to inventory storage is a high-risk gamble.

Industry insiders who have long operated in the Apple ecosystem noted that third-party manufacturers typically prepare three months in advance to secure a head start on the initial 'buy-a-phone-buy-a-case' window. They wait for Apple's official release before developing new products, as the golden opportunity has already passed.

The information source is not limited to official channels. During the production stage, supply chain leaks, prototype designs, and industry rumors can all provide enough information for mature manufacturers to develop cases based on dimensions, camera placement, and button layouts.

This year, there is an additional variable: Apple's Indian core manufacturing partner, Tata Electronics, was hit by a ransomware attack in June, resulting in over 200,000 leaked files (including motherboard diagrams, chip parameters, and real-machine test pieces) on the dark web, dubbed the most severe data breach in Apple's history. New Delhi has intervened in the investigation, giving accessory manufacturers more substantial 'public information' than in previous years.

However, the risks are higher. The flat iPhone has undergone numerous iterations, giving case manufacturers valuable experience. The foldable screen involves hinges, body thickness, opening and closing structures, and screen shape, making any key dimension change potentially render pre-made molds obsolete. In other words, the 'pre-sale' gamble for foldable cases is much greater than that for Pro models.

Sources close to the matter revealed that Apple plans to release only two high-end Pro models and the first foldable iPhone in the coming month, with standard and SE models to be released in the first half of 2027, forming a 'Pro autumn release, basic model spring release' schedule. For the accessory industry, this means a shift from 'one-time concentrated pre-sales' to 'long-cycle, high-frequency relay' production.

items.title: 美銀曝最優「AI泡沫交易」：建議同時做多「傲慢」與「偏見」
paras: 在人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮持續之際，美銀證券首席策略師Michael Hartnett認為，當前市場的最佳交易策略並非單押AI，而是同時做多「傲慢」（AI科技龍頭）與「偏見」（遭市場冷落的資產），藉此掌握名目GDP泡沫進入最後階段時可能出現的雙向行情。
美銀最新報告顯示，美銀牛熊指標上週由9.7小幅降至9.3，仍處於極度看多區間，但「賣出」訊號持續有效。
與此同時，近期資金流向出現明顯分化，科技股遭遇7週來最大單週資金流出，黃金則吸引今年1月以來最大單週資金流入；大宗商品今年以來總報酬率達58.9%，比特幣則下跌近28%。
美銀指出，現在市場仍相信「不要買債券、不要押美元、繼續買AI」，因為AI是最強成長主題，而且市場認為政策制定者不會輕易讓股市崩盤。
但該行提醒，未來如果美債殖利率繼續飆升、選民對生活成本更加不滿，或市場多頭持倉過度集中，都可能讓AI牛市開始失去上行動能。

AI「傲慢」搭配資產「偏見」　美銀提出雙向布局策略

Hartnett認為，從過往資產泡沫經驗來看，最佳的泡沫交易方式，是同時做多代表AI科技本身的「傲慢」，以及市場長期冷落、可能在名目GDP最終衝頂階段受惠的「偏見」資產。
美銀援引歷史案例指出，1999年網路泡沫以及2007至2008年次貸危機期間，都曾出現被市場忽視的資產在主導泡沫接近頂峰前，受惠於資金外溢的情況。
以目前市場環境來看，美銀認為「消費類股」最可能重現這種走勢。
另一方面，美銀建議放空AI相關債券，因為AI資本支出規模已超過1兆美元，加上企業淨現金流為負，未來可能面臨大量發債需求。
美銀指出，自5月26日牛熊指標首次出現賣出訊號以來，標普500指數仍累計上漲4%，MSCI全球指數也上漲3%。
該行提醒，市場持倉過度集中可能打亂牛市節奏，但真正要終結多頭行情，需要三項條件同時出現，包括持倉過度集中、企業獲利預期過於樂觀，以及政策轉向緊縮。
不過，目前這三項因素尚未同時成立。
從歷史表現來看，美銀牛熊指標成立以來共出現17次賣出訊號，全球股市在訊號出現後2至3個月平均下跌2%至3%，命中率約60%，最大回撤幅度則介於15%至20%。

黃金、大宗商品吸金　科技股出現7週最大流出

值得注意的是，近期資金流向進一步反映市場偏好的轉變。
上週，黃金基金單週淨流入63億美元，創今年1月以來最大單週流入；大宗商品今年以來總報酬率達58.9%，在各類資產中居首，其中原油今年以來上漲43%。
相較之下，科技基金上週淨流出12億美元，創7週以來最大單週流出。歐洲股票基金則吸引12億美元淨流入，創今年2月以來最大流入規模；南韓股票基金也連續第7週出現資金淨流入。
固定收益市場同樣出現資金回流。投資級債券單週吸引106億美元，創5週來最高；新興市場債券則流入14億美元，創7週來最高。現金類資產單週吸金254億美元。

美銀私人客戶股票配置創新高　現金比重降至紀錄低點

美銀私人客戶數據顯示，目前管理資產規模達4.7兆美元，其中股票配置比重升至66.4%，創歷史新高；債券配置降至17%，為2022年3月以來最低；現金配置則降至9.4%，創有紀錄以來最低水準。此外，股票單週淨流入規模也創2022年9月以來最大。
債券配置方面，私人客戶正略微拉長持有期限。今年以來，2年至10年期美國國債配置增加15%，而期限短於1年的國庫券配置則自去年11月以來減少逾30%。不過，30年期長債仍未受到青睞。
過去4週，私人客戶透過ETF買進日本債券、市政債券及抗通膨債券，同時減持新興市場債務、公用事業與金融類股ETF。
美銀同時警告，美國國家債務即將突破40兆美元，預估到2029年7月可能達到50兆美元。
過去12個月，美國聯邦政府利息支出已達1.4兆美元，在5年期美債殖利率降至3.25%以下之前，相關成本仍將持續增加。
與此同時，美國30年期國債以5.126%的殖利率完成發行，創25年來最高水準，但美股當天仍同步創下歷史新高，顯示市場「避開債券」的交易邏輯仍然有效。
值得注意的是，儘管2026年整體殖利率走高，REITs、小型股、生技股及區域銀行等過去受到冷落、對利率較敏感的資產近期反而開始跑贏大盤。
美銀認為，這可能反映市場已提前押注殖利率見頂。
報告認為，美日近期的匯率干預已向市場釋放訊號，顯示美國政府不希望10年期美債殖利率突破5%。
策略師預期，核心CPI在美國期中選舉前可降至2.1%至2.6%，屆時聯準會（Fed）主席華許（Kevin Warsh）可能透過Jackson Hole演說及9月利率會議釋放「任務完成」的訊號，再配合日本央行升息，進一步限制美債殖利率的上行空間。

黃金與香港地產成「避美元」交易選項

在「避開美元」的布局上，美銀提出兩項交易方向。
首先是做多黃金，將黃金視為因應美元貶值、債券市場崩跌及資產通膨的對沖工具，而近期黃金基金大幅吸金也反映市場對此交易的需求。
另一項策略則是布局香港房地產。美銀以「買進被羞辱的資產、賣出傲慢資產」概括這項交易邏輯。恒生地產指數目前處於約30年前的水準，估值約為12倍本益比。
美銀認為，亞洲正進入過去40年來第3輪長期多頭行情，主要由日本、南韓科技產業與中國AI共同推動。
與此同時，香港則可能受惠於杜拜的地緣政治吸引力與新加坡的稅務優勢相對減弱。

美國期中選舉成AI牛市關鍵政治變數

美銀將11月3日美國期中選舉視為影響市場後續走勢的重要事件。報告指出，如果共和黨守住參議院，且德州州長Greg Abbott成功連任，AI領軍的風險資產行情可能在2027年進一步加速。
反之，如果民主黨在11月取得參議院控制權，或拿下德州州長席位，股市、美元與債券殖利率可能在年底前出現超過10%的跌幅。
其中，德州州長選舉被美銀視為「負擔能力」與「AI資料中心」政策方向之間的選擇。
目前德州已有335座資料中心，另有247座正在規劃興建。Abbott近期宣布暫停資料中心擴張，反映選民對能源電網穩定性與生活成本的疑慮。
此外，美銀也關注後續幾項重要政策時程，包括：

8月28日聯準會主席華許在Jackson Hole的演講、
9月16日聯準會利率會議，
以及9月18日日本央行會議。


市場目前對聯準會升息的機率估計為35%，日本央行升息機率則為74%。

items.title: AI「偏空」隱憂現！美銀警告：基礎建設成本恐推升利率、使美股承壓
items.title_en: AI "Bearish" Risks Surface! Bank of America Warns Infrastructure Costs May Push Up Rates, Pressuring US Stocks
paras: 基於人工智慧（AI）能協助企業以更低成本提高產出、取代部分人力，進而降低薪資支出，AI長期被經濟學家與央行官員視為有助抑制通膨的新技術。然而，專家指出，這一切的發生可能還要「再等等」。
《Business Insider》報導指出，AI抑制通膨這項「長期利多」可能尚未到來。與此同時，AI基礎建設快速擴張所帶來的成本，反而已開始對物價形成上行壓力。
美國7月消費者物價指數（CPI）報告於上週三（12日）公布後，相關跡象更加明顯。數據顯示，電腦價格單月上漲3.5%，軟體價格過去一年則大漲約40%。
美國銀行(BAC-US) 近日指出，再加上資料中心爭相取得電力所推升的能源成本，以及企業將AI導入成本轉嫁給消費者，AI開始呈現出推升通膨的特徵。
美銀經濟學家Stephen Juneau表示，AI不僅推高電子產品的投入成本，也正在帶來正向的財富效應，進而支撐消費需求。
他指出：「聯準會（Fed）主席華許（Kevin Warsh）一直強調的AI降通膨效應，恐怕還得再等一段時間。」
分析指出，這對股市來說，從兩方面都令人擔憂，包括短期與長期利率。
就殖利率曲線短端而言，AI推升通膨將使利率政策更加複雜。通膨越高，聯準會面臨的升息壓力就越大，可能進一步提高隔夜拆款利率。
報導指出，這將對經濟活動形成抑制，並可能拖慢企業獲利成長，而企業獲利正是支撐股市的重要因素。
Sevens Report Research創辦人Tom Essaye表示，AI基礎建設擴張不太可能造成一輪持續性的高通膨，但確實提高聯準會在9月會議上一次性升息的可能性。
另一方面，通膨升溫也可能推高長期債券殖利率。當投資人預期通膨將侵蝕資產實質價值，通常會要求更高的報酬率。
目前，美國10年期國債殖利率已升至4.64%，高於今年初的4.15%。
MRB Partners在一份給客戶的報告中表示，儘管影響長期利率的因素很多，但高額的投資支出正協助推升債券殖利率。該機構預期，長期殖利率仍將進一步走高，可能對股市造成不利影響。
MRB Partners全球策略合夥人Philip Colmar在報告中表示：「我們對美國國債的看空展望，最終將對美股構成問題。」
他進一步指出，自2020年以來，每當10年期美債殖利率出現明顯向上突破時，「股市都曾出現劇烈修正。」
paras_en: Based on AI’s ability to help companies increase output at lower cost and replace some labor, thereby reducing wage expenses, AI has long been seen by economists and central bankers as a new technology that could help curb inflation.
Business Insider reports that the long‑term inflation‑reducing benefit of AI may not have arrived yet, and the rapid expansion of AI infrastructure is already creating upward price pressure.

After the US July Consumer Price Index report was released last Wednesday (the 12th), the signs became clearer, showing computer prices rose 3.5% month‑over‑month and software prices jumped about 40% over the past year.

Bank of America (BAC‑US) recently noted that rising energy costs from data centers scrambling for power and companies passing AI implementation costs onto consumers are giving AI an inflation‑raising character.
Bank of America economist Stephen Juneau said AI not only raises input costs for electronic products but also creates a positive wealth effect that supports consumer demand.
He added, “The Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s emphasis on AI’s deflationary impact may still require more time before it materializes.”
Analysts say this worries the stock market from two angles: short‑term and long‑term rates.

On the short end of the yield curve, AI‑driven inflation makes monetary policy more complex; higher inflation increases pressure on the Fed to raise rates, potentially lifting the overnight fed funds rate further.
The report notes this could dampen economic activity and slow corporate profit growth, which is a key driver of equity markets.

Sevens Report Research founder Tom Essaye said AI infrastructure expansion is unlikely to trigger a sustained high‑inflation episode but does raise the odds of a one‑time rate hike at the Fed’s September meeting.
On the other hand, rising inflation could also push long‑term bond yields higher, as investors demand higher returns when they expect inflation to erode real asset values.
Currently, the US 10‑year Treasury yield has climbed to 4.64%, up from 4.15% at the start of the year.

MRB Partners told clients that although many factors affect long‑term rates, large investment outlays are helping lift bond yields, and the firm expects yields to keep rising, potentially hurting equities.
MRB Partners global strategy partner Philip Colmar said, “Our bearish outlook on US Treasuries will ultimately pose problems for US stocks.”
He further noted that since 2020, every time the 10‑year Treasury yield has made a clear upward breakout, the stock market has experienced a sharp correction.

items.title: 長鑫科技市值逼近英特爾！衝上5405億美元、超越騰訊、躋身全球第24大企業
items.title_en: Chingxin Technology's Market Value Approaches Intel's, Surpassing Tencent to Become the 24th Largest Global Enterprise
paras: 中國記憶體晶片大廠長鑫科技(688825-CN) 上市後股價持續攀升，市值迅速躋身全球最具價值企業之列。
根據《Business Insider》報導，長鑫科技上週五（14日）在上海科創板收盤上漲4%。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，長鑫科技市值達5,405億美元，僅次於市值5,526億美元的英特爾(INTC-US) ，並超越市值5,058億美元的中國科技巨頭騰訊(00700-HK) ，在LSEG全球企業市值排名中位居第24名。
長鑫科技市值快速攀升之際，英特爾股價上月受到整體晶片股遭遇拋售，以及市場對大規模人工智慧（AI）投資的疑慮影響而回落，使兩家公司之間的市值差距進一步縮小。
騰訊的市值同樣有所下滑。由於市場擔憂AI支出增加，以及AI可能對其軟體業務造成影響，騰訊在香港上市的股票今年以來已下跌約26%。
長鑫科技是中國最大的DRAM記憶體晶片生產商，總部位於中國東部安徽省。
該公司7月27日進行首次公開募股（IPO），募資約86億美元，上市首日股價即較IPO價格大漲466%，一舉成為中國上市公司中市值最高的企業。
Bernstein分析師近日在報告中指出，長鑫科技此次IPO為公司提供「更多現金用於資本支出」。
目前長鑫科技已是全球第4大DRAM生產商，排名僅次於三星電子(005930KS) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 與美光科技(MU-US) 。
野村證券上月預期，長鑫科技在全球DRAM產量中的占比，將從目前約10%提升至2028年底約18%。
paras_en: Chinese memory chip giant Chingxin Technology (688825-CN) has seen its stock price continue to rise after its listing, with its market value quickly joining the ranks of the world's most valuable companies.
According to a report by Business Insider, Chingxin Technology's stock price rose by 4% on Friday (14th) in the Shanghai Sci-Tech Innovation Board.

Based on data from the London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG), Chingxin Technology's market value has reached $540.5 billion, second only to Intel (INTC-US) with a market value of $552.6 billion, and surpassing Tencent (00700-HK) with a market value of $505.8 billion, ranking 24th in the LSEG global corporate market value rankings.

As Chingxin Technology's market value continues to rise rapidly, Intel's stock price fell last month due to the overall decline in chip stocks and market concerns about large-scale artificial intelligence (AI) investments, further narrowing the gap in market value between the two companies.

Tencent's market value has also declined, with its Hong Kong-listed stock falling by about 26% this year due to market concerns about increased AI spending and the potential impact on its software business.
Chingxin Technology is China's largest DRAM memory chip manufacturer, headquartered in Anhui Province, eastern China.

The company conducted its initial public offering (IPO) on July 27, raising approximately $8.6 billion, with its stock price surging 466% on the first day of listing, making it the Chinese listed company with the highest market value.
Bernstein analysts recently pointed out in a report that Chingxin Technology's IPO has provided the company with 'more cash for capital expenditures'.
Chingxin Technology is currently the world's fourth-largest DRAM producer, ranking behind Samsung Electronics (005930KS), SK Hynix (000660KS), and Micron Technology (MU-US).
Nomura Securities predicted last month that Chingxin Technology's share of global DRAM production would increase from around 10% to approximately 18% by the end of 2028.

items.title: 被「AI股神」爆倉拖累！Jane Street驚傳7月虧損150億美元
paras: 華爾街知名自營交易巨頭Jane Street罕見遭遇重大虧損。據多家媒體報導，Jane Street今年7月可能出現約150億美元虧損，若相關消息屬實，將是公司約10年來首次單月虧損。此次重創主要與其投資的人工智慧（AI）避險基金Situational Awareness爆倉，以及同期科技股劇烈波動有關。
值得注意的是，Jane Street遭遇巨額虧損之際，公司正同步推進一項約146億美元的債務再融資計畫，試圖透過發行新的私人債務，償還現有公開債券及浮動利率貸款，並將約110億美元的資本結構重新安排至私人投資人手中。
Pimco、Capital Group及Fidelity等大型機構均參與這項新債務融資。
此次虧損的主要導火線之一，是曾在今年上半年成為華爾街AI明星基金的Situational Awareness。
Situational Awareness由前OpenAI研究員Leopold Aschenbrenner創立，今年上半年大舉押注AI相關股票並取得可觀回報，基金資產規模也快速擴大。
然而，進入7月後，AI相關股票遭遇劇烈拋售，高槓桿部位迅速惡化，基金面臨追加保證金要求。
最終，Situational Awareness被迫大規模出售公開市場股票，並將大部分股票投資組合出售給億萬富豪Ken Griffin旗下的Citadel。基金遭遇的劇烈下跌，也直接波及包括Jane Street在內的投資人。
Jane Street在內部備忘錄中承認，由於Situational Awareness上半年表現突出，公司此前持續增加對該基金的投資。但隨著基金大幅回撤，Jane Street目前持有的這項投資已「基本回到年初的水準」，不過從整體投資週期來看仍處於獲利狀態。
不過，Situational Awareness並非Jane Street此次巨額虧損的唯一原因。
《路透》援引Jane Street內部備忘錄指出，公司在亞洲非AI股票上的多頭部位同樣遭遇損失，而這些股票此前也曾是今年表現較好的資產。
Jane Street表示，公司很大程度上是在同一組交易組合上出現虧損，而這些交易在第二季曾創造強勁的超額報酬。
公司並指出，7月AI曝險股票大幅下跌，其中部分曝險程度較高的記憶體晶片與半導體股票，跌幅約達50%。
因此，此次虧損反映出的並非單一基金爆倉，而是Jane Street先前表現優異的交易部位，在市場風格快速轉變後出現集中回撤。

7月虧損150億美元　Jane Street年內交易收入仍超400億美元

儘管7月遭遇重大打擊，Jane Street整體交易業務今年仍維持強勁表現。
《彭博》與《路透》引述知情人士指出，Jane Street今年以來的淨交易收入仍超過400億美元，不僅已超越公司2025年創下紀錄的396億美元全年交易收入，也高於華爾街大型銀行及其他主要做市商同期的交易收入。
因此，儘管150億美元級別的單月虧損規模罕見，但目前仍不足以代表Jane Street核心業務模式受到破壞。
Jane Street目前的應對方式也並非全面收縮交易，而是針對此次虧損暴露出的風險進行調整。
公司在內部備忘錄中表示，未來將對風險承擔採取「更加有選擇性」的方式，並已關閉相當一部分在7月造成虧損的特定風險曝險，同時降低其他交易策略的風險承擔。

Jane Street推進146億美元債務再融資

就在巨額虧損消息傳出的同時，Jane Street也正在進行大規模債務重組。
《金融時報》報導，Jane Street本週推進約146億美元的債務融資，由摩根大通牽頭，交易分為3批債券，Pimco、Capital Group及Fidelity等大型機構投資人均參與其中。
這項交易主要是重新調整Jane Street的融資結構。公司計畫利用新的私人債務，償還浮動利率貸款及現有公開債券，將更多債務轉移至私人市場。
對高度重視交易策略與財務資訊保密性的自營交易公司而言，這項融資安排也具有特殊意義。
《金融時報》指出，Jane Street甚至願意承擔較高融資成本，以換取降低公開資訊揭露程度。此次再融資預計將產生數億美元的一次性成本，而新的債務融資成本也高於過去的公開市場融資。

AI基金爆倉凸顯槓桿交易風險

Situational Awareness事件的影響並不僅限於單一基金的投資損失，其背後也反映出現代主經紀商體系中的風險傳導機制。
當高槓桿AI投資遭遇股價下跌時，基金可能面臨追加保證金要求，進而被迫出售持股；主經紀商則可能同步收縮風險曝險，進一步促使大量資產被拋售。
Situational Awareness的交易由多家大型銀行提供融資及主經紀服務。先前報導指出，美國銀行、高盛及摩根大通等機構均參與相關融資體系。隨著AI股票價格快速下跌，主經紀商要求基金補充抵押品，最終促使基金大規模出售股票投資組合。
而Citadel以折價價格接手大量股票，則成為這一市場結構中的另一環。當高槓桿機構被迫出售資產時，擁有充足資本與流動性的交易機構可以承接折價資產。
先前報導指出，Citadel旗下股票基金7月上漲約14%，部分原因就是以折價價格接手Situational Awareness的股票組合，而相關AI股票之後出現反彈。

Jane Street開始收縮部分風險部位

對於過去多年持續創造盈利紀錄的Jane Street而言，7月的巨額虧損也促使公司重新調整風險承擔。
Jane Street合夥人Batty在內部備忘錄中表示，公司已關閉相當一部分在7月造成損失的特定風險曝險，同時降低其他策略的風險承擔。
不過，他也指出，目前公司的持倉與當前風險承受能力相符，市場交易量依然強勁，短週期交易策略的盈利能力也持續改善。
這顯示Jane Street目前並未將7月虧損視為核心交易模式失效，而是針對近期暴露出的風險進行調整。
分析指出，隨著AI相關交易在資本市場持續受到高度關注，Jane Street此次巨額虧損，也讓外界重新聚焦於AI資產波動、槓桿部位及交易機構風險管理之間的關聯。

items.title: 美國太空採購改制衝擊營收，York能見度下降、全年財測下修32%
items.title_en: U.S. Space Procurement Reform Hits Revenue, York's Visibility Drops, Full-Year Forecast Cut by 32%
paras: 2026年08月16日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國政府持續擴大太空領域的投資，但衛星製造商York Space Systems(YSS-US)卻將2026年營收預估中位數由5.7億美元降至3.9億美元，下修1.8億美元、幅度約32%。原因不是政府減少採購，而是採購方式從直接招標大型專案，改為先建立合格供應商名單，再逐案發出任務訂單。
這項改變拉長York從入選供應商到取得實際訂單的時間，也讓原本預計今年取得並認列的新業務延後至2027年。公司追蹤的商機雖超過115億美元，潛在未授予合約達18.5億美元，但第2季積壓訂單仍季減8%至5.92億美元，反映商機尚未轉成正式訂單。

從一次取得大型合約，改成兩階段採購
美國政府過去通常直接針對大型衛星或太空系統招標。York得標後即可投入設計與生產，並隨著專案執行逐步認列收入。
現在政府逐漸改採IDIQ模式，將採購拆成兩個階段。第一階段先選出合格供應商，第二階段等需求明確後，再向入選公司發出具有實際金額與工作內容的任務訂單。
對政府而言，IDIQ建立完成後，可依照不同需求快速下單，不必每次重新進行完整招標。但對York而言，入選IDIQ只代表取得未來競標資格，並不等於已經拿到訂單，因此更難預估合約金額與營收認列時間。

入選9.81億美元合約池，不等於取得9.81億美元訂單
美國太空軍建立的NITE-STAR IDIQ，就是這種新採購模式的例子。合約總額上限為9.81億美元，涵蓋兩個五年下單期，用於太空測試、訓練、技術開發及系統整合。
York與波音、洛克希德馬丁、Northrop Grumman及Rocket Lab等15家公司共同入選。然而，9.81億美元是整個合約池的採購上限，不是York已取得的訂單，也不是由15家公司平均分配。
York必須等待太空軍提出具體需求，再與其他入選廠商競爭任務訂單。最終收入取決於訂單何時釋出、規模多大，以及York能取得多少份額。

新業務延後，幾乎解釋全部財測下修
York原先預估2026年營收約5.7億美元，其中約30%、相當於1.71億美元，來自尚未取得的新業務。公司原本假設今年能拿到部分大型合約，並在專案啟動後開始認列收入。
但政府優先建立IDIQ合約池，大型專案沒有依照原先預期直接招標。York因此將今年尚未取得的新業務收入全部移出財測，使全年營收預估降至3.75億至4.05億美元，中位數減少1.8億美元。
公司今年雖已取得8項合約，提案得標率達88%，其中6項來自新採購模式，但目前多數仍是供應商資格、示範案或初期任務，尚未進入大規模部署。

2027年能否拿到大型任務訂單是關鍵
York認為，收入只是由2026年延後至2027年，並非政府需求消失。IDIQ平台完成後，政府確實可以更快發出後續任務訂單，但大型訂單的時間與金額仍不確定。
因此，超過115億美元的商機不能直接視為未來營收。York必須先從合約池取得具體任務訂單，再由小型測試進入大規模部署，收入才會真正增加。
後續重點不是York又入選多少個IDIQ，而是政府何時開始發出大型任務訂單，以及York能從15家甚至更多合格供應商中分到多少。若訂單在2027年快速落地，今年減少的收入才可能補回；若採購時程繼續延後，公司的營收能見度仍會偏低。

paras_en: On August 16, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) — The U.S. government continues to expand investment in the space sector, but satellite manufacturer York Space Systems (YSS‑US) has lowered its 2026 revenue median estimate from $570 million to $390 million, a reduction of $180 million or about 32%. The cause is not a cut in government purchases, but a shift in procurement from direct large‑project tenders to first establishing a qualified supplier list and then issuing task orders case by case.

This change lengthens the time for York to move from being selected as a supplier to securing actual orders, pushing new business that was expected to be booked and recognized this year into 2027. While the company tracks opportunities exceeding $11.5 billion, with $1.85 billion of potential contracts not yet awarded, its Q2 backlog fell 8% quarter‑over‑quarter to $592 million, indicating that the pipeline has not yet turned into firm orders.

From winning a single large contract to a two‑stage procurement The U.S. government previously tended to issue direct tenders for large satellites or space systems. Once York won a contract, it could begin design and production and recognize revenue progressively as the project proceeded.

Now the government is gradually adopting an IDIQ model, splitting procurement into two phases. In the first phase, qualified suppliers are selected; in the second phase, once requirements are clear, task orders with specific dollar amounts and work scopes are issued to the selected firms.

For the government, an IDIQ framework allows rapid ordering for varying needs without conducting a full tender each time. For York, being selected for an IDIQ only secures future competition eligibility and does not guarantee an order, making it harder to forecast contract values and revenue timing.

Being selected for a $981 million contract pool does not equal receiving a $981 million order The NITE‑STAR IDIQ established by the U.S. Space Force exemplifies this new procurement style. The contract pool has a ceiling of $981 million covering two five‑year ordering periods for space testing, training, technology development, and system integration.

York was chosen together with Boeing, Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, Rocket Lab and 10 other companies. However, the $981 million is the total procurement limit for the pool, not an order already secured by York nor an amount to be split evenly among the 15 firms.

York must wait for the Space Force to issue specific requirements and then compete with the other selected vendors for task orders. Final revenue will depend on when orders are released, their size, and the share York can capture.

The delayed new business almost fully explains the forecast cut York originally projected 2026 revenue of about $570 million, with roughly 30%—or $171 million—coming from yet‑to‑be‑won new business. The company had assumed it would secure part of a large contract this year and begin recognizing revenue once the project started.

But the government prioritized building the IDIQ pool, and large projects were not tendered directly as originally expected. Consequently, York removed all projected revenue from unawarded new business from its outlook, lowering the full‑year revenue estimate to $375 million‑$405 million, a median reduction of $180 million.

The company has already secured eight contracts this year, achieving an 88% proposal win rate, with six of them stemming from the new procurement model. Most of these are still supplier qualifications, demonstration projects, or early‑stage tasks and have not yet moved into large‑scale deployment.

Whether York can obtain large task orders in 2027 is critical York believes the revenue will simply be shifted from 2026 to 2027 rather than disappearing due to lack of demand. Once the IDIQ platform is in place, the government can indeed issue follow‑on task orders more quickly, but the timing and size of large orders remain uncertain.

Thus, the $11.5 billion of opportunities cannot be directly treated as future revenue. York must first win concrete task orders from the contract pool, then scale from small tests to full‑scale deployment before revenue truly rises.

The next focus is not how many additional IDIQs York gets selected for, but when the government starts issuing large task orders and how much York can capture out of the 15—or potentially more—qualified suppliers. If orders materialize quickly in 2027, this year’s revenue shortfall could be recovered; if procurement timelines keep slipping, the company’s revenue visibility will remain low.
